  .mini-fb.c{background:#f0fdf4;color:var(--green)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--green)!important;display:block;}
  .mini-fb.w{background:#fef2f2;color:var(--red)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--red)!important;display:block;}

  /* VOCAB */
  .vocab-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-bottom:24px;font-size:14px;}
  .vocab-table thead tr{background:var(--bi3);}
  .vocab-table thead th{padding:10px 16px;text-align:left;font-weight:600;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;font-size:13px;}
  .vocab-table tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:var(--bi3-bg);}
  .vocab-table tbody tr:nth-child(odd){background:#fff;}
  .vocab-table tbody td{padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #bfdbfe;color:#374151;vertical-align:top;line-height:1.5;}
  .vocab-table tbody td:first-child{font-weight:700;color:var(--bi3-dk)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-dk)!important;white-space:nowrap;}

  /* CPT CONNECTION */
  .cpt-connection{background:#fefce8;border:1px solid #fde68a;border-left:4px solid #f59e0b;border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;padding:20px 24px;margin:28px 0;}
  .cpt-connection-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#92400e!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#92400e!important;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .cpt-connection h3{font-size:16px!important;font-weight:700!important;color:#78350f!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#78350f!important;margin:16px 0 8px!important;}
  .cpt-connection p{font-size:14px!important;color:#78350f!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#78350f!important;line-height:1.7!important;margin-bottom:12px!important;}
  .cpt-connection a{color:#b45309!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#b45309!important;font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;}
  .cpt-connection code{background:#fef3c7;color:#78350f!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#78350f!important;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:5px;font-size:13px;}
  .cpt-stems{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
  .cpt-stems li{background:#fffef5;border:1px solid #fde68a;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:13px!important;color:#78350f!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#78350f!important;line-height:1.6;}
  .cpt-code{background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px;padding:14px 16px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;margin:6px 0 12px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;display:block;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;}

  /* EMAIL */
  .email-capture{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a 0%,#1e40af 100%);border-radius:12px;padding:24px 28px;margin-bottom:36px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .email-capture-text{flex:1;min-width:200px;}
  .email-capture-eyebrow{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .email-capture h3{font-size:16px!important;font-weight:700!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;margin-bottom:4px!important;}
  .email-capture p{font-size:13px!important;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;margin-bottom:0!important;line-height:1.5!important;}
  .email-capture-form{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;flex-shrink:0;}
  .email-capture-input{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff!important;font-size:14px;font-family:inherit;min-width:180px;outline:none;}
  .email-capture-btn{padding:10px 20px!important;background:var(--bi3)!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;border:none!important;border-radius:8px!important;font-size:14px!important;font-weight:600!important;cursor:pointer!important;font-family:inherit!important;}
  .email-capture-success{display:none;font-size:14px;color:#93c5fd!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#93c5fd!important;font-weight:600;padding:10px 0;}

  /* MCQ */
  .mcq-section{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:14px;padding:28px;margin-bottom:40px;}
  .mcq-section-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:24px;padding-bottom:16px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--bi3-bg);}
  .mcq-section-icon{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--bi3-bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .mcq-section-title{font-family:"DM Serif Display",serif;font-size:20px;color:var(--navy)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--navy)!important;}
  .mcq-section-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--slate);}
  .mcq-item{margin-bottom:28px;padding-bottom:28px;border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;}
  .mcq-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;margin-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0;}
  .mcq-q-num{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:8px;}
  .diff-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:100px;margin-left:8px;background:#fef2f2;color:#b91c1c!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#b91c1c!important;border:1px solid #fca5a5;}
  .mcq-q-text{font-size:15px!important;font-weight:600!important;color:#0f1f3d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#0f1f3d!important;line-height:1.6!important;margin-bottom:12px!important;}
  .predict-note{font-size:12px;font-style:italic;color:#64748b!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#64748b!important;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .mcq-code{background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;margin:10px 0 14px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;line-height:1.75;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;white-space:pre;overflow-x:auto;display:block;}
  .mcq-code .k{color:#93c5fd!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#93c5fd!important;}
  .mcq-code .s{color:#f9a8d4!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#f9a8d4!important;}
  .mcq-code .n{color:#fde68a!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fde68a!important;}
  .mcq-code .c{color:#64748b!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#64748b!important;font-style:italic;}
  .mcq-roman{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:10px 0 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;}
  .mcq-roman li{font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;color:#1e293b!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#1e293b!important;background:#f1f5f9;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;}
  .mcq-roman li strong{color:var(--bi3-dk)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-dk)!important;font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;margin-right:8px;}
  .mcq-options{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .mcq-option{display:flex!important;align-items:flex-start!important;gap:12px!important;padding:11px 14px!important;border:2px solid #e2e8f0!important;border-radius:8px!important;cursor:pointer!important;background:#f8fafc!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;line-height:1.5!important;text-align:left!important;width:100%!important;font-family:inherit!important;}
  .mcq-option:hover{border-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;background:var(--bi3-bg)!important;}
  .mcq-option.correct{border-color:var(--green)!important;background:#f0fdf4!important;color:#14532d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#14532d!important;}
  .mcq-option.incorrect{border-color:var(--red)!important;background:#fef2f2!important;color:#7f1d1d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#7f1d1d!important;}
  .mcq-option.revealed-correct{border-color:var(--green)!important;background:#f0fdf4!important;}
  .mcq-option-letter{font-weight:700!important;color:var(--bi3)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3)!important;flex-shrink:0!important;min-width:18px!important;}
  .mcq-option.correct .mcq-option-letter{color:#14532d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#14532d!important;}
  .mcq-option.incorrect .mcq-option-letter{color:#7f1d1d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#7f1d1d!important;}
  .mcq-feedback{display:none!important;padding:12px 16px!important;border-radius:8px!important;font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.6!important;margin-top:8px!important;}
  .mcq-feedback.show{display:block!important;}
  .mcq-feedback.correct-fb{background:#f0fdf4!important;color:#14532d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#14532d!important;border:1px solid #bbf7d0!important;}
  .mcq-feedback.incorrect-fb{background:#fef2f2!important;color:#7f1d1d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#7f1d1d!important;border:1px solid #fecaca!important;}

  /* GAME */
  .game-section{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a 0%,#1e40af 100%);border-radius:14px;padding:28px;margin-bottom:40px;}
  .game-badge{display:inline-block;background:rgba(147,197,253,.15);border:1px solid rgba(147,197,253,.35);color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .game-title{font-family:"DM Serif Display",serif!important;font-size:24px!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;margin-bottom:4px!important;}
  .game-sub{font-size:13px!important;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;margin-bottom:20px!important;}
  .vt-score-bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 20px;margin-bottom:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}
  .vt-stat{text-align:center;}
  .vt-stat-val{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;line-height:1;}
  .vt-stat-lbl{font-size:10px;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;margin-top:2px;}
  .vt-code-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:12px;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .vt-code-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .vt-code-lines{font-family:monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:2;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;}
  .vt-line{display:block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;white-space:pre;}
  .vt-line.hl{background:rgba(147,197,253,.2);color:#93c5fd!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#93c5fd!important;}
  .vt-question{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .vt-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .vt-btn{padding:12px;border-radius:9px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;font-family:monospace;transition:all .15s;}
  .vt-btn:hover{border-color:var(--bi3-lt);background:rgba(26,86,219,.2);}
  .vt-btn.c{border-color:#4ade80;background:rgba(74,222,128,.15);color:#4ade80!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#4ade80!important;}
  .vt-btn.w{border-color:#f87171;background:rgba(248,113,113,.15);color:#f87171!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#f87171!important;}
  .vt-btn.rv{border-color:#4ade80;background:rgba(74,222,128,.08);}
  .vt-fb{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:12px;display:none;line-height:1.5;}
  .vt-fb.c{background:rgba(74,222,128,.1);color:#4ade80!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#4ade80!important;display:block;}
  .vt-fb.w{background:rgba(248,113,113,.1);color:#f87171!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#f87171!important;display:block;}
  .vt-next{display:none;width:100%;padding:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:8px;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;}
  .vt-next.show{display:block;}
  .vt-results{display:none;text-align:center;padding:20px;}
  .vt-results.show{display:block;}
  .vt-res-score{font-family:"DM Serif Display",serif;font-size:52px;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;line-height:1;}
  .vt-res-lbl{font-size:14px;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .vt-res-msg{font-size:14px;color:#bfdbfe!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#bfdbfe!important;margin-bottom:20px;line-height:1.6;}
  .vt-restart{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:8px;padding:11px 24px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;}

  /* CODE EDITOR (Pyodide live) */
  .code-editor-section{background:#0f172a;border-radius:14px;padding:28px;margin-bottom:40px;}
  .code-editor-badge{display:inline-block;background:rgba(147,197,253,.15);border:1px solid rgba(147,197,253,.35);color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .code-editor-title{font-family:"DM Serif Display",serif!important;font-size:22px!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;margin-bottom:4px!important;}
  .code-editor-sub{font-size:13px!important;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;margin-bottom:20px!important;line-height:1.6;}
  .code-problem{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:10px;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .scaffold-badge{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:100px;background:rgba(147,197,253,.15);color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;border:1px solid rgba(147,197,253,.35);margin-bottom:8px;}
  .code-problem-num{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .code-problem-prompt{font-size:14px!important;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;line-height:1.6!important;margin-bottom:12px!important;}
  .code-problem-prompt code{background:rgba(147,197,253,.12);color:#bfdbfe!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#bfdbfe!important;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:5px;font-size:12px;}
  .code-textarea{width:100%;min-height:120px;background:#020617;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:8px;padding:14px 16px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;color:#e2e8f0!important;resize:vertical;outline:none;line-height:1.8;}
  .code-textarea:focus{border-color:var(--bi3-lt);}
  .code-btn-row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;}
  .code-run-btn{padding:9px 20px!important;background:var(--bi3)!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;border:none!important;border-radius:7px!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:700!important;cursor:pointer!important;font-family:inherit!important;}
  .code-run-btn:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait;}
  .code-hint-btn,.code-sol-btn{padding:9px 16px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)!important;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)!important;border-radius:7px!important;font-size:13px!important;cursor:pointer!important;font-family:inherit!important;}
  .code-output{margin-top:10px;background:#020617;border-radius:8px;padding:12px 16px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;min-height:44px;display:none;line-height:1.7;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;}
  .code-output.show{display:block;}
  .code-output.ok{color:#4ade80!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#4ade80!important;}
  .code-output.err{color:#f87171!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#f87171!important;}
  .code-hint{margin-top:8px;background:rgba(147,197,253,.06);border:1px solid rgba(147,197,253,.2);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:13px;color:#bfdbfe!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#bfdbfe!important;display:none;line-height:1.6;}
  .code-hint.show{display:block;}
  .code-solution{margin-top:8px;background:rgba(74,222,128,.06);border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.2);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;color:#bbf7d0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#bbf7d0!important;display:none;white-space:pre;line-height:1.8;overflow-x:auto;}
  .code-solution.show{display:block;}

  /* FAQ */
  .faq-section{margin-bottom:40px;}
  .faq-section h2{font-family:"DM Serif Display",serif!important;font-size:24px!important;color:var(--navy)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--navy)!important;margin-bottom:14px!important;padding-bottom:10px!important;border-bottom:2px solid var(--bi3-bg)!important;}
  .faq-item{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:10px;overflow:hidden;}
  .faq-q{width:100%;text-align:left;padding:16px 20px;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:15px!important;font-weight:600!important;color:var(--navy)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--navy)!important;font-family:inherit!important;line-height:1.4!important;}
  .faq-q:hover{background:#f8fafc;}
  .faq-icon{font-size:18px;color:var(--bi3)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3)!important;flex-shrink:0;transition:transform .2s;font-style:normal;}
  .faq-item.open .faq-icon{transform:rotate(45deg);}
  .faq-a{display:none;padding:0 20px 16px;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;line-height:1.7!important;border-top:1px solid #f1f5f9;}
  .faq-item.open .faq-a{display:block;}
  .faq-a code{background:#eef2ff;color:#1e3a8a!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#1e3a8a!important;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:5px;font-size:13px;}

  /* RELATED + SUPERPACK + TEACHER + NAV */
  .related-links{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:12px;padding:24px;margin-bottom:40px;}
  .related-links h3{font-size:15px!important;font-weight:700!important;color:var(--navy)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--navy)!important;margin-bottom:14px!important;}
  .related-links-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:8px;}
  .related-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:#f8fafc;text-decoration:none;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:500!important;color:var(--bi3)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3)!important;border:1px solid #bfdbfe;transition:background .15s;line-height:1.3;}
  .related-link:link,.related-link:visited{color:var(--bi3)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3)!important;}
  .related-link:hover{background:var(--bi3-bg);}
  .related-ext{color:var(--slate)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--slate)!important;border-color:#e2e8f0;}
  .superpack-slim{background:#fff;border:1px solid #bfdbfe;border-radius:10px;padding:16px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:36px;}
  .superpack-slim-icon{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--bi3-bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .superpack-slim-text{font-size:14px;color:var(--navy)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--navy)!important;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3;}
  .superpack-slim-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);font-weight:400;display:block;margin-top:2px;}
  .superpack-slim-btn{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:6px!important;background:var(--bi3)!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;padding:9px 18px!important;border-radius:7px!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:600!important;text-decoration:none!important;white-space:nowrap!important;}
  .superpack-slim-btn:link,.superpack-slim-btn:visited{color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;}
  .teacher-callout{background:#f0f9ff;border:1px solid #bae6fd;border-radius:10px;padding:18px 22px;margin-bottom:28px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;}

    <div class="hook-box">
      <div class="hook-label">💡 Think about this first</div>
      <p>Real decisions are rarely a single yes or no. A streaming app asks: are you logged in? If yes, do you have a subscription? If yes, is the show available in your region? Each answer opens a new question. That is nesting. And when a program must pick one label out of many, an A, B, C, or F, it uses a multiway chain. This lesson is about controlling exactly which path runs.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="lesson-section">
      <h2>What "Nested" Means</h2>
      <p>A <strong>nested conditional</strong> is a conditional statement placed inside another conditional statement. The key rule is timing: the <strong>inner</strong> condition is only checked when the <strong>outer</strong> condition is true. If the outer condition is false, the entire inner conditional is skipped without ever being evaluated. Nesting is how a program asks a second question only after the first one has already been answered a certain way.</p>

      <p>Here the outer test <code>x > 5</code> is false (x is 3), so the whole inner IF is skipped and never runs. The program jumps straight to <code>print("done")</code>. Reading nesting correctly means always resolving the outer condition first, then only descending into the inner block when the outer was true.</p>

      <h2>Multiway Selection: Choosing One of Many</h2>
      <p>Often you need more than two outcomes: a grade of A, B, C, or F; a shipping tier; a category. In Python this is an <code>if</code> followed by one or more <code>elif</code> branches and a final <code>else</code>. The rule that makes it work: Python checks the branches top to bottom and runs the <strong>first</strong> one whose condition is true, then skips all the rest. At most one branch ever runs.</p>

<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">}</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-kw">ELSE</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">{</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-kw">DISPLAY</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-str">"C"</span><span class="ps-var">)</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">}</span>

</div>
      <p>With x at 82, the first condition <code>x >= 90</code> is false, the second <code>x >= 80</code> is true, so it prints B and stops. It never even checks the else. Notice the pseudocode on the right expresses the exact same logic as nested IF/ELSE, because the exam reference sheet has no elif. They are two spellings of one idea.</p>

    <div class="lesson-section">
      <h2>Order Matters: the Overlap Trap</h2>
      <p>Because a multiway chain runs the first true branch, the <strong>order</strong> of the conditions can change the result when the conditions overlap. If a broad condition is placed before a more specific one, the broad condition catches the value first and the specific branch becomes unreachable.</p>
      <div class="code-panel-wrap">
  <div class="code-panel-tabs">
    <button class="code-tab py active" onclick="switchTab(this,'py','pan-3')">🐛 Python (buggy)</button>
    <button class="code-tab pseudo" onclick="switchTab(this,'pseudo','pan-3')">📋 Pseudocode (fixed)</button>
  </div>
  <div class="code-pane active" id="pan-3-py"><pre><span class="py-comment"># WRONG order: broad test first</span>
<span class="py-kw">if</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">x</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">></span><span class="py-var">=</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-num">50</span><span class="py-var">:</span>
<span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-kw">print</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-str">"big"</span><span class="py-var">)</span>
<span class="py-kw">elif</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">x</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">></span><span class="py-var">=</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-num">100</span><span class="py-var">:</span>
<span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-kw">print</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-str">"huge"</span><span class="py-var">)</span>
<span class="py-kw">else</span><span class="py-var">:</span>
<span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-kw">print</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-str">"small"</span><span class="py-var">)</span></pre></div>
  <div class="code-pane" id="pan-3-pseudo"><pre><span class="ps-comment"># RIGHT order: specific test first</span>
<span class="ps-kw">IF</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-var">x</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">></span><span class="ps-var">=</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-num">100</span><span class="ps-var">)</span>
<span class="ps-var">{</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-kw">DISPLAY</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-str">"huge"</span><span class="ps-var">)</span>
<span class="ps-var">}</span>
<span class="ps-kw">ELSE</span>
<span class="ps-var">{</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-kw">IF</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-var">x</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">></span><span class="ps-var">=</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-num">50</span><span class="ps-var">)</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">{</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-kw">DISPLAY</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-str">"big"</span><span class="ps-var">)</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">}</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-kw">ELSE</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">{</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-kw">DISPLAY</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-str">"small"</span><span class="ps-var">)</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">}</span>
<span class="ps-var">}</span></pre></div>
</div>
      <p>On the left, any value 100 or larger is also 50 or larger, so <code>x >= 50</code> fires first and prints "big" even when the value deserved "huge." The specific case never gets a chance. The fix, shown on the right, is to test the most specific or most extreme condition first and let the broader ones follow.</p>
      <div class="callout-trap">
        <div class="callout-trap-label">⚠ Reachability</div>
        <p>A branch that can never run for any valid input is a bug called a dead branch. It usually means an earlier condition already covers every case the later branch was meant to catch. When you write a chain, ask of every branch: is there any input that reaches this one? On the Create Task, an unreachable branch means your selection does not really demonstrate the skill.</p>
      </div>

    <div class="lesson-section">
      <h2>Tracing Nested and Multiway Code</h2>
      <p>Use one disciplined procedure and these questions become mechanical:</p>
      <ol>
        <li>Evaluate the <strong>outer</strong> condition first using current values.</li>
        <li>If it is false, skip the entire inner block, then continue after it. Do not peek inside.</li>
        <li>If it is true, step into the inner conditional and evaluate it the same way.</li>
        <li>For an if / elif / else chain, check conditions top to bottom and stop at the first true one.</li>
        <li>Exactly one path through the structure runs. Trace only that path.</li>
      </ol>

  </div>

<span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-kw">if</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">w</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">></span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-num">10</span><span class="py-var">:</span>
<span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-kw">print</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-str">"big positive"</span><span class="py-var">)</span>
<span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-kw">else</span><span class="py-var">:</span>
<span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-kw">print</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-str">"small positive"</span><span class="py-var">)</span>

<span class="ps-kw">IF</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-var">w</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">></span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-num">0</span><span class="ps-var">)</span>
<span class="ps-var">{</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-kw">IF</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-var">w</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">></span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-num">10</span><span class="ps-var">)</span>

<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-kw">DISPLAY</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-str">"big positive"</span><span class="ps-var">)</span>

      <h2>Key Vocabulary</h2>
      <table class="vocab-table">
        <thead><tr>
<th>Term</th>
<th>Definition</th>
<th>Example</th>
</tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr>
<td>Nested conditional</td>
<td>A conditional statement inside another conditional statement</td>
<td>an IF inside an IF</td>
</tr>
          <tr>
<td>Inner condition</td>
<td>The condition checked only after the outer condition is true</td>
<td>
<code>if x > 1:</code> inside</td>
</tr>
          <tr>
<td>Multiway selection</td>
<td>Choosing one of several outcomes with if / elif / else</td>
<td>A, B, C, or F</td>
</tr>
          <tr>
<td>elif</td>
<td>Python keyword for "else if"; checked only if earlier conditions were false</td>
<td><code>elif x >= 80:</code></td>
</tr>
          <tr>
<td>First-true rule</td>
<td>In a chain, only the first branch whose condition is true runs</td>
<td>top to bottom</td>
</tr>
          <tr>
<td>Dead branch</td>
<td>A branch that can never run because an earlier condition covers it</td>
<td>ordering bug</td>
</tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
    <div class="cpt-connection">
      <div class="cpt-connection-label">📋 Create Performance Task • Nested selection that manages complexity</div>
      <p>Nested and multiway conditionals are where your Create Task program shows it can "handle varied input values," the exact language the rubric rewards. A single IF makes one decision; a nested or multiway structure makes a decision and then a follow-up decision, which is what real programs do.</p>
      <h3>A point-earning example</h3>
      <p>Imagine a program that sorts a user's quiz percentage into a letter and then a message:</p>
      <div class="cpt-code">IF (pct >= 90)
{
    grade <- "A"
}
ELSE
{
    IF (pct >= 80)
    {
        grade <- "B"
    }
    ELSE
    {
        grade <- "C"
    }
}</div>
      <p>In your written response, identify the selection, name the condition, and describe each reachable branch:</p>
      <ul class="cpt-stems">
        <li>"The nested selection first tests <code>pct >= 90</code>; if that is false it tests <code>pct >= 80</code>."</li>
        <li>"Each branch assigns a different value to <code>grade</code>, so the program produces one of three distinct results depending on the input."</li>
        <li>"This structure lets the program respond to a range of scores rather than a single yes-or-no case, which is how it handles varied input."</li>
      </ul>
      <h3>The trap to avoid</h3>
      <p>Order your conditions so every branch is reachable. If you write the broad test first, a specific branch becomes dead code and your selection no longer demonstrates the skill. Test the most specific case first, then broaden. <a href="/pages/ap-csp-course-create-task">See the full Create Task module →</a></p>

    <div class="faq-section">
      <h2>Frequently Asked Questions</h2>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFAQ(this)">What is a nested conditional?<i class="faq-icon">+</i></button>
        <div class="faq-a">A nested conditional is a conditional statement placed inside another conditional statement. The inner condition is only checked when the outer condition is true. If the outer condition is false, the entire inner conditional is skipped.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFAQ(this)">How is elif different from a second if?<i class="faq-icon">+</i></button>
        <div class="faq-a">An <code>elif</code> is only checked when every condition above it was false, and at most one branch in the whole chain runs. Two separate <code>if</code> statements are each checked independently, so more than one can run. Use elif when the outcomes are mutually exclusive.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFAQ(this)">Why does the order of my elif branches matter?<i class="faq-icon">+</i></button>
        <div class="faq-a">Python runs the first branch whose condition is true and skips the rest. If a broad condition comes before a more specific one, the broad one catches the value first and the specific branch becomes unreachable dead code. Test the most specific or most extreme case first.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFAQ(this)">How does a nested conditional relate to AND?<i class="faq-icon">+</i></button>
        <div class="faq-a">Reaching the inner block of a nested IF requires the outer condition AND the inner condition to both be true. A nested IF with no else is often equivalent to a single IF that joins the two conditions with <code>and</code>.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFAQ(this)">How do nested conditionals help my Create Task?<i class="faq-icon">+</i></button>
        <div class="faq-a">They let your program handle varied input by making a decision and then a follow-up decision. In your written response you identify the selection, name the conditions, and describe each reachable branch. Make sure every branch can actually run for some input.</div>
      </div>

function loadScriptOnce(src){return new Promise(function(res,rej){
  if(document.querySelector('script[data-pyodide]')){res();return;}
  var s=document.createElement('script');s.src=src;s.setAttribute('data-pyodide','1');
  s.onload=function(){res();};s.onerror=function(){rej(new Error('script load failed'));};
  document.head.appendChild(s);});}
function ensurePy(){if(window.__pyPromise)return window.__pyPromise;
  window.__pyPromise=(async function(){await loadScriptOnce(PY_URL+'pyodide.js');
    var py=await loadPyodide({indexURL:PY_URL});window.__pyodide=py;return py;})();
  return window.__pyPromise;}
function cleanErr(msg){if(!msg)return 'error';var lines=String(msg).trim().split('\n');return lines.slice(-3).join('\n');}
function execUser(py,code){var output='',err=null;
  try{py.runPython('import sys, io\n__old_out = sys.stdout\nsys.stdout = io.StringIO()\nsys.stderr = sys.stdout');
    try{var ns=py.globals.get('dict')();py.runPython(code,{globals:ns});ns.destroy();}
    catch(e){err=cleanErr(e.message);}
    output=py.runPython('sys.stdout.getvalue()');}
  catch(e2){err=cleanErr((e2&&e2.message)||String(e2));}
  finally{try{py.runPython('sys.stdout = __old_out\nsys.stderr = __old_out');}catch(e3){}}
  return {output:output,err:err};}

    <div class="lesson-objectives">
      <h2>After this lesson, you will be able to:</h2>
      <ul>
        <li><span>Explain why programs use random values for games, simulations, and sampling</span></li>
        <li><span>Use RANDOM(a, b) and random.randint(a, b) to generate a random integer</span></li>
        <li><span>Know that both endpoints a and b are possible results</span></li>
        <li><span>Count the possible outcomes of a range with the b - a + 1 rule</span></li>
        <li><span>Seed the generator to make random output repeatable for testing</span></li>
        <li><span>Use a random value inside a conditional or loop for your Create Performance Task</span></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="score-impact">📈 <span><strong>Exam weight:</strong> Random values appear in tracing and reasoning items across Big Idea 3, and they are a favorite way to test the inclusive range and the b - a + 1 count. Miscounting endpoints is one of the most common traps.</span>
</div>
    <div class="hook-box">
      <div class="hook-label">💡 Think about this first</div>
      <p>A game that rolled the same number every turn would be no fun, and a simulation that never varied would be useless. Programs create surprise with random values: a value the computer picks that you cannot predict in advance. You cannot say which number will come up, but you can say exactly which numbers are possible and how many there are. This lesson is about controlling that range with confidence.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="lesson-section">
      <h2>Why Programs Need Randomness</h2>
      <p>Some programs must do something <strong>different</strong> each time they run. A dice game should not roll the same number every turn. A simulation of traffic or weather needs variety to be realistic. A quiz app that samples a question should not always pick the first one. For all of these, a program uses a <strong>random value</strong>: a value the computer chooses that the programmer cannot predict in advance.</p>
      <p>In AP pseudocode you generate one with <code>RANDOM(a, b)</code>. In Python the closest match is <code>random.randint(a, b)</code>. Both return a random <strong>integer</strong>, and both include <strong>a</strong> and <strong>b</strong> as possible results.</p>
      <div class="code-panel-wrap">
  <div class="code-panel-tabs">
    <button class="code-tab py active" onclick="switchTab(this,'py','pan-1')">🐛 Python</button>
    <button class="code-tab pseudo" onclick="switchTab(this,'pseudo','pan-1')">📋 AP Pseudocode</button>
  </div>
  <div class="code-pane active" id="pan-1-py"><pre><span class="py-kw">import</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">random</span>
<span class="py-var">roll</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">=</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">random</span><span class="py-var">.</span><span class="py-var">randint</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-num">1</span><span class="py-var">,</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-num">6</span><span class="py-var">)</span>
<span class="py-kw">print</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-var">roll</span><span class="py-var">)</span></pre></div>
  <div class="code-pane" id="pan-1-pseudo"><pre><span class="ps-var">roll</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"><</span><span class="ps-var">-</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">RANDOM</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-num">1</span><span class="ps-var">,</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-num">6</span><span class="ps-var">)</span>
<span class="ps-kw">DISPLAY</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-var">roll</span><span class="ps-var">)</span></pre></div>
</div>
      <p>Each time this runs, <code>roll</code> may be a different integer from 1 to 6. Run it three times and you might see 4, then 1, then 6. That unpredictability is the whole point. You cannot know the exact value ahead of time, but you do know the <strong>set of values it could be</strong>, and that is what the exam tests.</p>
      <div class="callout-exam">
        <div class="callout-exam-label">🎯 What the exam expects</div>
        <p>The CED (AAP-3.E) states that <code>RANDOM(a, b)</code> "generates and returns a random integer from a to b, including a and b." The word to burn in is <strong>including</strong>: both endpoints are possible results. Python's <code>random.randint(a, b)</code> behaves the same way, inclusive of both a and b.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="mini-ex">
        <div class="mini-ex-label">✍ Mini Exercise 1 • Count the outcomes</div>
        <div class="mini-ex-q">How many <strong>different</strong> integers could <code>n</code> be after this line?</div>

<span class="ps-kw">DISPLAY</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-var">n</span><span class="ps-var">)</span></pre></div>

    <div class="lesson-section">
      <h2>Counting the Possible Values</h2>
      <p>Because both endpoints are included, the number of possible results of <code>RANDOM(a, b)</code> is <strong>b - a + 1</strong>, not b - a. The <code>+ 1</code> is there because you are counting the fenceposts, not the gaps between them. From 2 to 8 the values are 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, which is seven numbers, and 8 - 2 + 1 equals 7.</p>
      <div class="code-panel-wrap">
  <div class="code-panel-tabs">
    <button class="code-tab py active" onclick="switchTab(this,'py','pan-2')">🐛 Python</button>
    <button class="code-tab pseudo" onclick="switchTab(this,'pseudo','pan-2')">📋 AP Pseudocode</button>
  </div>
  <div class="code-pane active" id="pan-2-py"><pre><span class="py-var">lo</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">=</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-num">2</span>
<span class="py-var">hi</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">=</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-num">8</span>
<span class="py-var">count</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">=</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">hi</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">-</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">lo</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">+</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-num">1</span>
<span class="py-kw">print</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-var">count</span><span class="py-var">)</span></pre></div>
  <div class="code-pane" id="pan-2-pseudo"><pre><span class="ps-var">lo</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"><</span><span class="ps-var">-</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-num">2</span>
<span class="ps-var">hi</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"><</span><span class="ps-var">-</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-num">8</span>
<span class="ps-var">count</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"><</span><span class="ps-var">-</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">hi</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">-</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">lo</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">+</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-num">1</span>
<span class="ps-kw">DISPLAY</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-var">count</span><span class="ps-var">)</span></pre></div>
</div>
      <p>Forgetting the <code>+ 1</code> is the single most common random-value mistake on the exam. If a question asks how many outcomes are possible, or asks you to make exactly a certain number of outcomes, reach for <strong>b - a + 1</strong> every time.</p>
      <div class="callout-trap">
        <div class="callout-trap-label">⚠ Off by one</div>
        <p>A range that looks like it has 6 values might have 5, or 7. <code>RANDOM(1, 6)</code> has 6 outcomes (1 through 6). <code>RANDOM(0, 6)</code> has 7 outcomes (0 through 6). <code>RANDOM(5, 5)</code> has exactly 1 outcome: it always returns 5. Always list or count the endpoints, then apply b - a + 1.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="mini-ex">
        <div class="mini-ex-label">✍ Mini Exercise 2 • Spot the flaw</div>

<span class="py-var">roll</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">=</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-num">6</span>
<span class="py-kw">print</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-var">roll</span><span class="py-var">)</span></pre></div>

    <div class="lesson-section">
      <h2>Random, but Repeatable: Seeding</h2>
      <p>By design, random values change from run to run, which makes them hard to test. To get the same sequence every time, a program can <strong>seed</strong> the generator with <code>random.seed(k)</code> before drawing values. A seed does not remove the randomness; it just fixes which random sequence you get, so the same seed always produces the same results.</p>
      <div class="code-panel-wrap">
  <div class="code-panel-tabs">
    <button class="code-tab py active" onclick="switchTab(this,'py','pan-3')">🐛 Python (seeded)</button>
    <button class="code-tab pseudo" onclick="switchTab(this,'pseudo','pan-3')">📋 Pseudocode</button>
  </div>
  <div class="code-pane active" id="pan-3-py"><pre><span class="py-kw">import</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">random</span>
<span class="py-var">random</span><span class="py-var">.</span><span class="py-var">seed</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-num">7</span><span class="py-var">)</span>
<span class="py-kw">print</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-var">random</span><span class="py-var">.</span><span class="py-var">randint</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-num">1</span><span class="py-var">,</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-num">6</span><span class="py-var">)</span><span class="py-var">)</span>
<span class="py-kw">print</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-var">random</span><span class="py-var">.</span><span class="py-var">randint</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-num">1</span><span class="py-var">,</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-num">6</span><span class="py-var">)</span><span class="py-var">)</span></pre></div>
  <div class="code-pane" id="pan-3-pseudo"><pre><span class="ps-kw">DISPLAY</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-var">RANDOM</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-num">1</span><span class="ps-var">,</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-num">6</span><span class="ps-var">)</span><span class="ps-var">)</span>
<span class="ps-kw">DISPLAY</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-var">RANDOM</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-num">1</span><span class="ps-var">,</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-num">6</span><span class="ps-var">)</span><span class="ps-var">)</span></pre></div>
</div>
      <p>With <code>random.seed(7)</code> set first, those two calls always print the same two numbers, in the same order, on every machine. That is why every practice problem below sets a seed: it makes the "random" output predictable so you can check your work. On the real exam and on the Create Task, you normally do <strong>not</strong> seed, because you want genuine variety.</p>
      <div class="callout-exam">
        <div class="callout-exam-label">🎯 Exam vs. practice</div>
        <p>AP pseudocode has no seed function; <code>RANDOM(a, b)</code> is always freshly random. Seeding is a Python testing convenience. Understand it, but know that exam questions about <code>RANDOM</code> ask which values are <em>possible</em>, never which exact value appears.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="lesson-section">
      <h2>Using a Random Value in a Decision</h2>
      <p>A random value becomes useful when the program acts on it. Generate the value, then feed it into a conditional to branch, or into a counter inside a loop to build a simulation. A coin flip is the classic example: draw 0 or 1, then decide.</p>
      <div class="code-panel-wrap">
  <div class="code-panel-tabs">
    <button class="code-tab py active" onclick="switchTab(this,'py','pan-4')">🐛 Python</button>
    <button class="code-tab pseudo" onclick="switchTab(this,'pseudo','pan-4')">📋 AP Pseudocode</button>
  </div>
  <div class="code-pane active" id="pan-4-py"><pre><span class="py-kw">import</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">random</span>
<span class="py-var">flip</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">=</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">random</span><span class="py-var">.</span><span class="py-var">randint</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-num">0</span><span class="py-var">,</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-num">1</span><span class="py-var">)</span>
<span class="py-kw">if</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">flip</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var">=</span><span class="py-var">=</span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-num">1</span><span class="py-var">:</span>
<span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-kw">print</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-str">"heads"</span><span class="py-var">)</span>
<span class="py-kw">else</span><span class="py-var">:</span>
<span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-var"> </span><span class="py-kw">print</span><span class="py-var">(</span><span class="py-str">"tails"</span><span class="py-var">)</span></pre></div>
  <div class="code-pane" id="pan-4-pseudo"><pre><span class="ps-var">flip</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"><</span><span class="ps-var">-</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">RANDOM</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-num">0</span><span class="ps-var">,</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-num">1</span><span class="ps-var">)</span>
<span class="ps-kw">IF</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-var">flip</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var">=</span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-num">1</span><span class="ps-var">)</span>
<span class="ps-var">{</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-kw">DISPLAY</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-str">"heads"</span><span class="ps-var">)</span>
<span class="ps-var">}</span>
<span class="ps-kw">ELSE</span>
<span class="ps-var">{</span>
<span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-var"> </span><span class="ps-kw">DISPLAY</span><span class="ps-var">(</span><span class="ps-str">"tails"</span><span class="ps-var">)</span>
<span class="ps-var">}</span></pre></div>
</div>
      <p>Here <code>RANDOM(0, 1)</code> returns one of two equally likely results. The IF turns that number into a word. This same pattern, generate a random value then branch on it, is how you would build a dice game, a random enemy spawn, or a sampled survey response in your own project.</p>

      <div class="cpt-connection-label">📋 Create Performance Task • A random value that drives your program</div>
      <p>Randomness is a natural way to make your Create Task program produce varied output and to show a meaningful use of an expression. A random value fed into a conditional or a loop lets one program behave differently each run, which is exactly the kind of behavior worth writing about in your response.</p>
      <h3>A point-earning example</h3>
      <p>Imagine a program that assigns a player a random target number and then reacts to it:</p>
      <div class="cpt-code">target <- RANDOM(1, 10)
IF (target > 5)
{
    DISPLAY("high target")
}
ELSE
{
    DISPLAY("low target")
}</div>
      <p>In your written response, name the source of the value and describe the range and its use:</p>
      <ul class="cpt-stems">
        <li>"The expression <code>RANDOM(1, 10)</code> generates a random integer from 1 to 10 inclusive, so there are ten equally likely outcomes."</li>
        <li>"Because the value is unpredictable, the program produces different results on different runs, which the conditional then responds to."</li>
        <li>"This use of a random value, combined with selection, lets the program handle varied input rather than a single fixed case."</li>
      </ul>
      <h3>The trap to avoid</h3>
      <p>Do not use <code>RANDOM</code> where you actually need a fixed value, and do not miscount the range. If your program is supposed to always start a score at 0, that is an assignment, not <code>RANDOM(0, 0)</code>. And if you claim a call has a certain number of outcomes, count with b - a + 1 so your description is accurate. <a href="/pages/ap-csp-course-create-task">See the full Create Task module →</a></p>

<div id="q2-fb-B" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. randint always returns an integer, never a decimal.</div>
<div id="q2-fb-C" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. randint returns any value in the range with equal chance, not always the larger one.</div>
<div id="q2-fb-D" class="mcq-feedback correct-fb">Correct. randint(1, 5) includes 5 but stops there, so 6 is impossible. To include 6 you must write randint(1, 6).</div>

    <div class="faq-section">
      <h2>Frequently Asked Questions</h2>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFAQ(this)">Does RANDOM(a, b) include a and b?<i class="faq-icon">+</i></button>
        <div class="faq-a">Yes. <code>RANDOM(a, b)</code> returns a random integer from a to b <strong>including both</strong> endpoints. Python's <code>random.randint(a, b)</code> works the same way. So <code>RANDOM(1, 6)</code> can return 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFAQ(this)">How many values can RANDOM(a, b) return?<i class="faq-icon">+</i></button>
        <div class="faq-a">Exactly <code>b - a + 1</code>. The plus one is there because both endpoints count. For example <code>RANDOM(2, 8)</code> can return 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, or 8, which is 8 - 2 + 1 = 7 values.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFAQ(this)">What is a seed and why do the practice problems use one?<i class="faq-icon">+</i></button>
        <div class="faq-a">A seed is a fixed starting value set with <code>random.seed(k)</code>. It makes the random sequence repeatable, so the same seed always gives the same numbers. The practice problems seed the generator so the output is predictable and can be checked. On the real exam and on your Create Task you normally do not seed.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFAQ(this)">When should I not use a random value?<i class="faq-icon">+</i></button>
        <div class="faq-a">Use a fixed assignment when a value must always be the same, like starting a score at 0. Using <code>RANDOM</code> where a constant is needed makes the program unpredictable in a way you did not intend. Reach for randomness only when you truly want variety.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFAQ(this)">How do random values help my Create Task?<i class="faq-icon">+</i></button>
        <div class="faq-a">A random value fed into a conditional or a loop lets your program produce different results on different runs, which shows it handles varied situations. In your response, name the call, state the inclusive range, and describe how the program reacts to the value.</div>
      </div>

  for(var i=0;i<shown;i++){text+='Hint '+(i+1)+': '+hints[i]+(i<shown-1?'\n\n':'');}
  box.textContent=text;box.className='code-hint show';box.style.whiteSpace='pre-wrap';
  LESSON_USAGE.hints[n]=shown;LESSON_USAGE.totalHints=_sumv(LESSON_USAGE.hints);updateUsage();
  if(CE_HINT_IDX[n]<hints.length-1)CE_HINT_IDX[n]++;
  var solBtn=document.getElementById('sol-btn-'+n);if(solBtn)solBtn.style.display='inline-block';}
function showSol(n){var box=document.getElementById('ce-sol-'+n);box.textContent=CE_SOL[n]||'';box.className='code-solution show';
  LESSON_USAGE.solutions[n]=1;LESSON_USAGE.totalSolutions=_sumv(LESSON_USAGE.solutions);updateUsage();}
var vtScore=0,vtQ=0,vtStreak=0,vtAnswered=false;
function vtRender(){if(vtQ>=VT_QS.length){vtShowResults();return;}vtAnswered=false;var q=VT_QS[vtQ];
  document.getElementById('vt-qn').textContent=(vtQ+1)+'/'+VT_QS.length;
  document.getElementById('vt-streak').textContent=vtStreak;
  var codeEl=document.getElementById('vt-code');codeEl.innerHTML='';
  q.lines.forEach(function(line,i){var span=document.createElement('span');
    span.className='vt-line'+(i===q.hl?' hl':'');span.textContent=line;codeEl.appendChild(span);});
  document.getElementById('vt-question').textContent=q.q;
  var optEl=document.getElementById('vt-options');optEl.innerHTML='';
  q.choices.forEach(function(ch,i){var btn=document.createElement('button');btn.className='vt-btn';btn.textContent=ch;
    btn.onclick=(function(idx){return function(){vtAnswer(idx);};})(i);optEl.appendChild(btn);});
  document.getElementById('vt-fb').className='vt-fb';document.getElementById('vt-next').className='vt-next';}
function vtAnswer(idx){if(vtAnswered)return;vtAnswered=true;var q=VT_QS[vtQ];
  var btns=document.querySelectorAll('.vt-btn');btns.forEach(function(b){b.onclick=null;});
  var fb=document.getElementById('vt-fb');
  if(idx===q.correct){vtScore++;vtStreak++;btns[idx].classList.add('c');fb.textContent='\u2713 Correct! '+q.exp;fb.className='vt-fb c';}
  else{vtStreak=0;btns[idx].classList.add('w');btns[q.correct].classList.add('rv');fb.textContent='\u2717 Not quite. '+q.exp;fb.className='vt-fb w';}
  document.getElementById('vt-score').textContent=vtScore;document.getElementById('vt-streak').textContent=vtStreak;
  document.getElementById('vt-next').className='vt-next show';}
function vtNext(){vtQ++;vtRender();}
function vtShowResults(){document.getElementById('vt-active').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('vt-results').className='vt-results show';
  document.getElementById('vt-res-score').textContent=vtScore+'/'+VT_QS.length;
  document.getElementById('vt-res-msg').textContent=VT_MSGS[Math.min(vtScore,VT_MSGS.length-1)];
  _activity({activity:'exercise-2',earned:vtScore,possible:VT_QS.length});}
function vtRestart(){vtScore=0;vtQ=0;vtStreak=0;vtAnswered=false;
  document.getElementById('vt-results').className='vt-results';
  document.getElementById('vt-active').style.display='block';
  document.getElementById('vt-score').textContent='0';vtRender();}
vtRender();

  .mini-fb{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:7px;margin-top:6px;display:none;line-height:1.5;}
  .mini-fb.c{background:#f0fdf4;color:var(--green)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--green)!important;display:block;}
  .mini-fb.w{background:#fef2f2;color:var(--red)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--red)!important;display:block;}

  /* VOCAB */
  .vocab-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-bottom:24px;font-size:14px;}
  .vocab-table thead tr{background:var(--bi3);}
  .vocab-table thead th{padding:10px 16px;text-align:left;font-weight:600;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;font-size:13px;}
  .vocab-table tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:var(--bi3-bg);}
  .vocab-table tbody tr:nth-child(odd){background:#fff;}
  .vocab-table tbody td{padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #bfdbfe;color:#374151;vertical-align:top;line-height:1.5;}
  .vocab-table tbody td:first-child{font-weight:700;color:var(--bi3-dk)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-dk)!important;white-space:nowrap;}

  /* CPT CONNECTION */
  .cpt-connection{background:#fefce8;border:1px solid #fde68a;border-left:4px solid #f59e0b;border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;padding:20px 24px;margin:28px 0;}
  .cpt-connection-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#92400e!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#92400e!important;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .cpt-connection h3{font-size:16px!important;font-weight:700!important;color:#78350f!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#78350f!important;margin:16px 0 8px!important;}
  .cpt-connection p{font-size:14px!important;color:#78350f!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#78350f!important;line-height:1.7!important;margin-bottom:12px!important;}
  .cpt-connection a{color:#b45309!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#b45309!important;font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;}
  .cpt-connection code{background:#fef3c7;color:#78350f!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#78350f!important;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:5px;font-size:13px;}
  .cpt-stems{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
  .cpt-stems li{background:#fffef5;border:1px solid #fde68a;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:13px!important;color:#78350f!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#78350f!important;line-height:1.6;}
  .cpt-code{background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px;padding:14px 16px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;margin:6px 0 12px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;display:block;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;}

  /* EMAIL */
  .email-capture{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a 0%,#1e40af 100%);border-radius:12px;padding:24px 28px;margin-bottom:36px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .email-capture-text{flex:1;min-width:200px;}
  .email-capture-eyebrow{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .email-capture h3{font-size:16px!important;font-weight:700!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;margin-bottom:4px!important;}
  .email-capture p{font-size:13px!important;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;margin-bottom:0!important;line-height:1.5!important;}
  .email-capture-form{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;flex-shrink:0;}
  .email-capture-input{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff!important;font-size:14px;font-family:inherit;min-width:180px;outline:none;}
  .email-capture-btn{padding:10px 20px!important;background:var(--bi3)!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;border:none!important;border-radius:8px!important;font-size:14px!important;font-weight:600!important;cursor:pointer!important;font-family:inherit!important;}
  .email-capture-success{display:none;font-size:14px;color:#93c5fd!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#93c5fd!important;font-weight:600;padding:10px 0;}

  /* MCQ */
  .mcq-section{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:14px;padding:28px;margin-bottom:40px;}
  .mcq-section-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:24px;padding-bottom:16px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--bi3-bg);}
  .mcq-section-icon{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--bi3-bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .mcq-section-title{font-family:"DM Serif Display",serif;font-size:20px;color:var(--navy)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--navy)!important;}
  .mcq-section-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--slate);}
  .mcq-item{margin-bottom:28px;padding-bottom:28px;border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;}
  .mcq-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;margin-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0;}
  .mcq-q-num{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:8px;}
  .diff-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:100px;margin-left:8px;background:#fef2f2;color:#b91c1c!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#b91c1c!important;border:1px solid #fca5a5;}
  .mcq-q-text{font-size:15px!important;font-weight:600!important;color:#0f1f3d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#0f1f3d!important;line-height:1.6!important;margin-bottom:12px!important;}
  .predict-note{font-size:12px;font-style:italic;color:#64748b!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#64748b!important;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .mcq-code{background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;margin:10px 0 14px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;line-height:1.75;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;white-space:pre;overflow-x:auto;display:block;}
  .mcq-code .k{color:#93c5fd!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#93c5fd!important;}
  .mcq-code .s{color:#f9a8d4!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#f9a8d4!important;}
  .mcq-code .n{color:#fde68a!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fde68a!important;}
  .mcq-code .c{color:#64748b!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#64748b!important;font-style:italic;}
  .mcq-roman{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:10px 0 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;}
  .mcq-roman li{font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;color:#1e293b!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#1e293b!important;background:#f1f5f9;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;}
  .mcq-roman li strong{color:var(--bi3-dk)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-dk)!important;font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;margin-right:8px;}
  .mcq-options{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .mcq-option{display:flex!important;align-items:flex-start!important;gap:12px!important;padding:11px 14px!important;border:2px solid #e2e8f0!important;border-radius:8px!important;cursor:pointer!important;background:#f8fafc!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;line-height:1.5!important;text-align:left!important;width:100%!important;font-family:inherit!important;}
  .mcq-option:hover{border-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;background:var(--bi3-bg)!important;}
  .mcq-option.correct{border-color:var(--green)!important;background:#f0fdf4!important;color:#14532d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#14532d!important;}
  .mcq-option.incorrect{border-color:var(--red)!important;background:#fef2f2!important;color:#7f1d1d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#7f1d1d!important;}
  .mcq-option.revealed-correct{border-color:var(--green)!important;background:#f0fdf4!important;}
  .mcq-option-letter{font-weight:700!important;color:var(--bi3)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3)!important;flex-shrink:0!important;min-width:18px!important;}
  .mcq-option.correct .mcq-option-letter{color:#14532d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#14532d!important;}
  .mcq-option.incorrect .mcq-option-letter{color:#7f1d1d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#7f1d1d!important;}
  .mcq-feedback{display:none!important;padding:12px 16px!important;border-radius:8px!important;font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.6!important;margin-top:8px!important;}
  .mcq-feedback.show{display:block!important;}
  .mcq-feedback.correct-fb{background:#f0fdf4!important;color:#14532d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#14532d!important;border:1px solid #bbf7d0!important;}
  .mcq-feedback.incorrect-fb{background:#fef2f2!important;color:#7f1d1d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#7f1d1d!important;border:1px solid #fecaca!important;}

  /* GAME */
  .game-section{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a 0%,#1e40af 100%);border-radius:14px;padding:28px;margin-bottom:40px;}
  .game-badge{display:inline-block;background:rgba(147,197,253,.15);border:1px solid rgba(147,197,253,.35);color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .game-title{font-family:"DM Serif Display",serif!important;font-size:24px!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;margin-bottom:4px!important;}
  .game-sub{font-size:13px!important;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;margin-bottom:20px!important;}
  .vt-score-bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 20px;margin-bottom:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}
  .vt-stat{text-align:center;}
  .vt-stat-val{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;line-height:1;}
  .vt-stat-lbl{font-size:10px;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;margin-top:2px;}
  .vt-code-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:12px;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .vt-code-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .vt-code-lines{font-family:monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:2;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;}
  .vt-line{display:block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;white-space:pre;}
  .vt-line.hl{background:rgba(147,197,253,.2);color:#93c5fd!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#93c5fd!important;}
  .vt-question{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .vt-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .vt-btn{padding:12px;border-radius:9px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;font-family:monospace;transition:all .15s;}
  .vt-btn:hover{border-color:var(--bi3-lt);background:rgba(26,86,219,.2);}
  .vt-btn.c{border-color:#4ade80;background:rgba(74,222,128,.15);color:#4ade80!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#4ade80!important;}
  .vt-btn.w{border-color:#f87171;background:rgba(248,113,113,.15);color:#f87171!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#f87171!important;}
  .vt-btn.rv{border-color:#4ade80;background:rgba(74,222,128,.08);}
  .vt-fb{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:12px;display:none;line-height:1.5;}
  .vt-fb.c{background:rgba(74,222,128,.1);color:#4ade80!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#4ade80!important;display:block;}
  .vt-fb.w{background:rgba(248,113,113,.1);color:#f87171!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#f87171!important;display:block;}
  .vt-next{display:none;width:100%;padding:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:8px;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;}
  .vt-next.show{display:block;}
  .vt-results{display:none;text-align:center;padding:20px;}
  .vt-results.show{display:block;}
  .vt-res-score{font-family:"DM Serif Display",serif;font-size:52px;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;line-height:1;}
  .vt-res-lbl{font-size:14px;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .vt-res-msg{font-size:14px;color:#bfdbfe!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#bfdbfe!important;margin-bottom:20px;line-height:1.6;}
  .vt-restart{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:8px;padding:11px 24px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;}

  /* CODE EDITOR (Pyodide live) */
  .code-editor-section{background:#0f172a;border-radius:14px;padding:28px;margin-bottom:40px;}
  .code-editor-badge{display:inline-block;background:rgba(147,197,253,.15);border:1px solid rgba(147,197,253,.35);color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .code-editor-title{font-family:"DM Serif Display",serif!important;font-size:22px!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;margin-bottom:4px!important;}
  .code-editor-sub{font-size:13px!important;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;margin-bottom:20px!important;line-height:1.6;}
  .code-problem{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:10px;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .scaffold-badge{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:100px;background:rgba(147,197,253,.15);color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;border:1px solid rgba(147,197,253,.35);margin-bottom:8px;}
  .code-problem-num{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .code-problem-prompt{font-size:14px!important;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;line-height:1.6!important;margin-bottom:12px!important;}

  .code-textarea{width:100%;min-height:120px;background:#020617;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:8px;padding:14px 16px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;color:#e2e8f0!important;resize:vertical;outline:none;line-height:1.8;}

  .code-btn-row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;}
  .code-run-btn{padding:9px 20px!important;background:var(--bi3)!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;border:none!important;border-radius:7px!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:700!important;cursor:pointer!important;font-family:inherit!important;}
  .code-run-btn:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait;}
  .code-hint-btn,.code-sol-btn{padding:9px 16px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)!important;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)!important;border-radius:7px!important;font-size:13px!important;cursor:pointer!important;font-family:inherit!important;}
  .code-output{margin-top:10px;background:#020617;border-radius:8px;padding:12px 16px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;min-height:44px;display:none;line-height:1.7;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;}

  .code-output.ok{color:#4ade80!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#4ade80!important;}
  .code-output.err{color:#f87171!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#f87171!important;}
  .code-hint{margin-top:8px;background:rgba(147,197,253,.06);border:1px solid rgba(147,197,253,.2);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:13px;color:#bfdbfe!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#bfdbfe!important;display:none;line-height:1.6;}
  .code-hint.show{display:block;}
  .code-solution{margin-top:8px;background:rgba(74,222,128,.06);border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.2);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;color:#bbf7d0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#bbf7d0!important;display:none;white-space:pre;line-height:1.8;overflow-x:auto;}
  .code-solution.show{display:block;}

  /* FAQ */
  .faq-section{margin-bottom:40px;}
  .faq-section h2{font-family:"DM Serif Display",serif!important;font-size:24px!important;color:var(--navy)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--navy)!important;margin-bottom:14px!important;padding-bottom:10px!important;border-bottom:2px solid var(--bi3-bg)!important;}
  .faq-item{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:10px;overflow:hidden;}
  .faq-q{width:100%;text-align:left;padding:16px 20px;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:15px!important;font-weight:600!important;color:var(--navy)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--navy)!important;font-family:inherit!important;line-height:1.4!important;}
  .faq-q:hover{background:#f8fafc;}
  .faq-icon{font-size:18px;color:var(--bi3)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3)!important;flex-shrink:0;transition:transform .2s;font-style:normal;}

  .faq-a{display:none;padding:0 20px 16px;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;line-height:1.7!important;border-top:1px solid #f1f5f9;}
  .faq-item.open .faq-a{display:block;}
  .faq-a code{background:#eef2ff;color:#1e3a8a!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#1e3a8a!important;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:5px;font-size:13px;}

  /* RELATED + SUPERPACK + TEACHER + NAV */
  .related-links{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:12px;padding:24px;margin-bottom:40px;}
  .related-links h3{font-size:15px!important;font-weight:700!important;color:var(--navy)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--navy)!important;margin-bottom:14px!important;}
  .related-links-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:8px;}
