<script>
(function(){
  var LIC = {
    copyright:{label:'Copyright',desc:'all rights reserved'},
    cc:{label:'Creative Commons',desc:'reuse allowed with conditions'},
    oss:{label:'Open Source',desc:'freely use and modify code'},
    pd:{label:'Public Domain',desc:'free for any use'}
  };
  var LIC_ORDER = ['copyright','cc','oss','pd'];

  var LIC_ROUNDS = [
    {scen:'You want to reuse a nature photo, but the creator only allows it if you give them credit.',ans:'cc',
     fb:'Creative Commons lets others reuse work under set conditions, like attribution (giving credit).'},
    {scen:'A developer posts a project so anyone can fork, use, and modify the code freely.',ans:'oss',
     fb:'Open Source software is released so anyone can freely use, study, and modify the code.'},
    {scen:'A brand-new song is still fully owned and controlled by the artist who wrote it.',ans:'copyright',
     fb:'Copyright means all rights reserved - the creator controls copying, sharing, and reuse.'},
    {scen:'You find a novel written in the year 1810; its protections have long expired.',ans:'pd',
     fb:'Once protections expire, work enters the Public Domain and is free for anyone to use.'},
    {scen:'A blog image is marked "reuse OK for non-commercial projects with a link back."',ans:'cc',
     fb:'Conditional reuse (non-commercial, share-alike, attribution) is the signature of Creative Commons.'},
    {scen:'A movie released this year - copying or redistributing it needs the studio permission.',ans:'copyright',
     fb:'New creative works are automatically Copyright: all rights reserved to the owner.'}
  ];

  var PII_ROUNDS = [
    {item:'Social Security number',sensitive:true,
     fb:'A Social Security number is highly sensitive PII - it can be used for identity theft. Protect it.'},
    {item:'Your home street address',sensitive:true,
     fb:'A home address is sensitive PII tied to your physical safety - keep it private.'},
    {item:'A public username / gamertag',sensitive:false,
     fb:'A username you chose for public play is meant to be seen - safe to share.'},
    {item:'Your favorite color',sensitive:false,
     fb:'A favorite color cannot identify or harm you - it is safe, non-sensitive info.'},
    {item:'Your date of birth plus full name together',sensitive:true,
     fb:'Full name plus birth date can be combined to impersonate you - sensitive PII to protect.'},
    {item:'The name of a movie you liked',sensitive:false,
     fb:'A movie preference reveals nothing that could identify or endanger you - safe to share.'}
  ];

  function shuffle(a){ a=a.slice(); for(var i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){ var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)); var t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t; } return a; }

  var rounds=[], idx=0, score=0, streak=0, best=0, answered=false;

  var el={
    round:document.getElementById('lm-round'),
    score:document.getElementById('lm-score'),
    streak:document.getElementById('lm-streak'),
    tag:document.getElementById('lm-tag'),
    scen:document.getElementById('lm-scen'),
    opts:document.getElementById('lm-opts'),
    fb:document.getElementById('lm-fb'),
    next:document.getElementById('lm-next'),
    play:document.getElementById('lm-play')
  };

  function buildRounds(){
    var lic = shuffle(LIC_ROUNDS).slice(0,5).map(function(r){ return {type:'lic',data:r}; });
    var pii = shuffle(PII_ROUNDS).slice(0,4).map(function(r){ return {type:'pii',data:r}; });
    rounds = lic.concat(pii);
  }

  function start(){
    buildRounds(); idx=0; score=0; streak=0; best=0; answered=false;
    el.play.innerHTML =
      '<span class="lm-tag lic" id="lm-tag">Licensing</span>'+
      '<div class="lm-scen" id="lm-scen"></div>'+
      '<div class="lm-opts" id="lm-opts"></div>'+
      '<div class="lm-fb" id="lm-fb"></div>'+
      '<button class="lm-next" id="lm-next">Next round ▶</button>';
    el.tag=document.getElementById('lm-tag');
    el.scen=document.getElementById('lm-scen');
    el.opts=document.getElementById('lm-opts');
    el.fb=document.getElementById('lm-fb');
    el.next=document.getElementById('lm-next');
    el.next.onclick=nextRound;
    render();
  }

  function render(){
    answered=false;
    var r=rounds[idx];
    el.round.textContent=(idx+1)+'/'+rounds.length;
    el.score.textContent=score;
    el.streak.textContent=streak;
    el.fb.className='lm-fb'; el.fb.textContent='';
    el.next.className='lm-next';
    el.opts.innerHTML='';

    if(r.type==='lic'){
      el.tag.className='lm-tag lic'; el.tag.textContent='Licensing';
      el.scen.textContent=r.data.scen;
      el.opts.className='lm-opts';
      shuffle(LIC_ORDER).forEach(function(key){
        var b=document.createElement('button');
        b.className='lm-opt'; b.type='button';
        b.innerHTML=LIC[key].label+'<span class="od">'+LIC[key].desc+'</span>';
        b.onclick=function(){ answerLic(key,b); };
        el.opts.appendChild(b);
      });
    } else {
      el.tag.className='lm-tag pii'; el.tag.textContent='Personal Data (PII)';
      el.scen.textContent='Data item: "'+r.data.item+'" - is this sensitive PII to protect, or safe to share?';
      el.opts.className='lm-opts two';
      var defs=[['sensitive','Sensitive PII','protect it - do not share'],['safe','Safe to share','not identifying / not sensitive']];
      shuffle(defs).forEach(function(d){
        var b=document.createElement('button');
        b.className='lm-opt'; b.type='button';
        b.innerHTML=d[1]+'<span class="od">'+d[2]+'</span>';
        b.onclick=function(){ answerPii(d[0],b); };
        el.opts.appendChild(b);
      });
    }
  }

  function lockOpts(){
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.opts.children,function(c){ c.disabled=true; });
  }

  function correct(fb){
    score += 10 + streak*2;
    streak += 1; if(streak>best) best=streak;
    el.score.textContent=score; el.streak.textContent=streak;
    el.fb.className='lm-fb show good';
    el.fb.innerHTML='✅ Correct! '+fb;
  }
  function wrong(fb){
    streak=0; el.streak.textContent=streak;
    el.fb.className='lm-fb show wrong';
    el.fb.innerHTML='❌ Not quite. '+fb;
  }

  function afterAnswer(){
    el.next.className='lm-next show';
    el.next.innerHTML = (idx+1>=rounds.length) ? 'See results →' : 'Next round ▶';
  }

  function answerLic(key,btn){
    if(answered) return; answered=true; lockOpts();
    var r=rounds[idx];
    if(key===r.data.ans){ btn.className='lm-opt ok'; correct(r.data.fb); }
    else {
      btn.className='lm-opt bad'; wrong(r.data.fb);
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.opts.children,function(c){
        if(c.innerHTML.indexOf(LIC[r.data.ans].label)===0) c.className='lm-opt ok';
      });
    }
    afterAnswer();
  }

  function answerPii(choice,btn){
    if(answered) return; answered=true; lockOpts();
    var r=rounds[idx];
    var isCorrect=(choice==='sensitive')===r.data.sensitive;
    if(isCorrect){ btn.className='lm-opt ok'; correct(r.data.fb); }
    else {
      btn.className='lm-opt bad'; wrong(r.data.fb);
      var want=r.data.sensitive?'Sensitive PII':'Safe to share';
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.opts.children,function(c){
        if(c.innerHTML.indexOf(want)===0) c.className='lm-opt ok';
      });
    }
    afterAnswer();
  }

  function nextRound(){
    idx++;
    if(idx>=rounds.length){ endGame(); return; }
    render();
  }

  function endGame(){
    el.round.textContent=rounds.length+'/'+rounds.length;
    var max=0; for(var i=0;i<rounds.length;i++){ max+=10+i*2; }
    var pct=Math.round(score/max*100);
    var msg;
    if(pct>=85) msg='Outstanding - you can tell Copyright from Creative Commons and guard PII like a pro.';
    else if(pct>=60) msg='Solid work. Remember: licenses set the terms for reusing other people work, and sensitive PII should stay private.';
    else msg='Keep practicing. Match each scenario to its license, and protect data that can identify or harm you.';
    el.play.innerHTML=
      '<div class="lm-end">'+
        '<h2>Run complete!</h2>'+
        '<div class="big">'+score+' pts</div>'+
        '<p>You answered '+rounds.length+' scenarios • best streak '+best+' • '+pct+'% of max points.</p>'+
        '<p>'+msg+'</p>'+
        '<button class="lm-again" id="lm-again">↻ Play again</button>'+
      '</div>';
    document.getElementById('lm-again').onclick=start;
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('apcsGameScore',{detail:{value:score}}));
  }

  start();
})();
</script>

  .vocab-table tbody td:first-child{font-weight:700;color:var(--bi3-dk)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-dk)!important;white-space:nowrap;}

  /* CPT CONNECTION */
  .cpt-connection{background:#fefce8;border:1px solid #fde68a;border-left:4px solid #f59e0b;border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;padding:20px 24px;margin:28px 0;}
  .cpt-connection-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#92400e!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#92400e!important;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .cpt-connection h3{font-size:16px!important;font-weight:700!important;color:#78350f!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#78350f!important;margin:16px 0 8px!important;}
  .cpt-connection p{font-size:14px!important;color:#78350f!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#78350f!important;line-height:1.7!important;margin-bottom:12px!important;}
  .cpt-connection a{color:#b45309!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#b45309!important;font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;}
  .cpt-connection code{background:#fef3c7;color:#78350f!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#78350f!important;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:5px;font-size:13px;}
  .cpt-stems{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
  .cpt-stems li{background:#fffef5;border:1px solid #fde68a;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:13px!important;color:#78350f!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#78350f!important;line-height:1.6;}
  .cpt-code{background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px;padding:14px 16px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;margin:6px 0 12px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;display:block;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;}

  /* EMAIL */
  .email-capture{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a 0%,#1e40af 100%);border-radius:12px;padding:24px 28px;margin-bottom:36px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .email-capture-text{flex:1;min-width:200px;}
  .email-capture-eyebrow{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .email-capture h3{font-size:16px!important;font-weight:700!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;margin-bottom:4px!important;}
  .email-capture p{font-size:13px!important;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;margin-bottom:0!important;line-height:1.5!important;}
  .email-capture-form{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;flex-shrink:0;}
  .email-capture-input{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff!important;font-size:14px;font-family:inherit;min-width:180px;outline:none;}
  .email-capture-btn{padding:10px 20px!important;background:var(--bi3)!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;border:none!important;border-radius:8px!important;font-size:14px!important;font-weight:600!important;cursor:pointer!important;font-family:inherit!important;}
  .email-capture-success{display:none;font-size:14px;color:#93c5fd!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#93c5fd!important;font-weight:600;padding:10px 0;}

  /* MCQ */
  .mcq-section{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:14px;padding:28px;margin-bottom:40px;}
  .mcq-section-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:24px;padding-bottom:16px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--bi3-bg);}
  .mcq-section-icon{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--bi3-bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .mcq-section-title{font-family:"DM Serif Display",serif;font-size:20px;color:var(--navy)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--navy)!important;}
  .mcq-section-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--slate);}
  .mcq-item{margin-bottom:28px;padding-bottom:28px;border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;}
  .mcq-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;margin-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0;}
  .mcq-q-num{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:8px;}
  .diff-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:100px;margin-left:8px;background:#fef2f2;color:#b91c1c!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#b91c1c!important;border:1px solid #fca5a5;}
  .mcq-q-text{font-size:15px!important;font-weight:600!important;color:#0f1f3d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#0f1f3d!important;line-height:1.6!important;margin-bottom:12px!important;}
  .predict-note{font-size:12px;font-style:italic;color:#64748b!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#64748b!important;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .mcq-code{background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;margin:10px 0 14px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;line-height:1.75;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;white-space:pre;overflow-x:auto;display:block;}
  .mcq-code .k{color:#93c5fd!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#93c5fd!important;}
  .mcq-code .s{color:#f9a8d4!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#f9a8d4!important;}
  .mcq-code .n{color:#fde68a!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fde68a!important;}
  .mcq-code .c{color:#64748b!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#64748b!important;font-style:italic;}
  .mcq-roman{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:10px 0 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;}
  .mcq-roman li{font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;color:#1e293b!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#1e293b!important;background:#f1f5f9;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;}
  .mcq-roman li strong{color:var(--bi3-dk)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-dk)!important;font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;margin-right:8px;}
  .mcq-options{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .mcq-option{display:flex!important;align-items:flex-start!important;gap:12px!important;padding:11px 14px!important;border:2px solid #e2e8f0!important;border-radius:8px!important;cursor:pointer!important;background:#f8fafc!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;line-height:1.5!important;text-align:left!important;width:100%!important;font-family:inherit!important;}
  .mcq-option:hover{border-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;background:var(--bi3-bg)!important;}
  .mcq-option.correct{border-color:var(--green)!important;background:#f0fdf4!important;color:#14532d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#14532d!important;}
  .mcq-option.incorrect{border-color:var(--red)!important;background:#fef2f2!important;color:#7f1d1d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#7f1d1d!important;}
  .mcq-option.revealed-correct{border-color:var(--green)!important;background:#f0fdf4!important;}
  .mcq-option-letter{font-weight:700!important;color:var(--bi3)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3)!important;flex-shrink:0!important;min-width:18px!important;}
  .mcq-option.correct .mcq-option-letter{color:#14532d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#14532d!important;}
  .mcq-option.incorrect .mcq-option-letter{color:#7f1d1d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#7f1d1d!important;}
  .mcq-feedback{display:none!important;padding:12px 16px!important;border-radius:8px!important;font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.6!important;margin-top:8px!important;}
  .mcq-feedback.show{display:block!important;}
  .mcq-feedback.correct-fb{background:#f0fdf4!important;color:#14532d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#14532d!important;border:1px solid #bbf7d0!important;}
  .mcq-feedback.incorrect-fb{background:#fef2f2!important;color:#7f1d1d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#7f1d1d!important;border:1px solid #fecaca!important;}

  /* GAME */
  .game-section{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a 0%,#1e40af 100%);border-radius:14px;padding:28px;margin-bottom:40px;}
  .game-badge{display:inline-block;background:rgba(147,197,253,.15);border:1px solid rgba(147,197,253,.35);color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .game-title{font-family:"DM Serif Display",serif!important;font-size:24px!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;margin-bottom:4px!important;}
  .game-sub{font-size:13px!important;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;margin-bottom:20px!important;}
  .vt-score-bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 20px;margin-bottom:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}
  .vt-stat{text-align:center;}
  .vt-stat-val{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;line-height:1;}
  .vt-stat-lbl{font-size:10px;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;margin-top:2px;}
  .vt-code-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:12px;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .vt-code-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .vt-code-lines{font-family:monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:2;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;}
  .vt-line{display:block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;white-space:pre;}
  .vt-line.hl{background:rgba(147,197,253,.2);color:#93c5fd!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#93c5fd!important;}
  .vt-question{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .vt-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .vt-btn{padding:12px;border-radius:9px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;font-family:monospace;transition:all .15s;}
  .vt-btn:hover{border-color:var(--bi3-lt);background:rgba(26,86,219,.2);}
  .vt-btn.c{border-color:#4ade80;background:rgba(74,222,128,.15);color:#4ade80!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#4ade80!important;}
  .vt-btn.w{border-color:#f87171;background:rgba(248,113,113,.15);color:#f87171!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#f87171!important;}
  .vt-btn.rv{border-color:#4ade80;background:rgba(74,222,128,.08);}
  .vt-fb{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:12px;display:none;line-height:1.5;}
  .vt-fb.c{background:rgba(74,222,128,.1);color:#4ade80!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#4ade80!important;display:block;}
  .vt-fb.w{background:rgba(248,113,113,.1);color:#f87171!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#f87171!important;display:block;}
  .vt-next{display:none;width:100%;padding:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:8px;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;}
  .vt-next.show{display:block;}
  .vt-results{display:none;text-align:center;padding:20px;}
  .vt-results.show{display:block;}
  .vt-res-score{font-family:"DM Serif Display",serif;font-size:52px;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;line-height:1;}
  .vt-res-lbl{font-size:14px;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .vt-res-msg{font-size:14px;color:#bfdbfe!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#bfdbfe!important;margin-bottom:20px;line-height:1.6;}
  .vt-restart{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:8px;padding:11px 24px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;}

  /* CODE EDITOR (Pyodide live) */
  .code-editor-section{background:#0f172a;border-radius:14px;padding:28px;margin-bottom:40px;}
  .code-editor-badge{display:inline-block;background:rgba(147,197,253,.15);border:1px solid rgba(147,197,253,.35);color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .code-editor-title{font-family:"DM Serif Display",serif!important;font-size:22px!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;margin-bottom:4px!important;}
  .code-editor-sub{font-size:13px!important;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;margin-bottom:20px!important;line-height:1.6;}
  .code-problem{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:10px;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .scaffold-badge{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:100px;background:rgba(147,197,253,.15);color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;border:1px solid rgba(147,197,253,.35);margin-bottom:8px;}
  .code-problem-num{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3-lt)!important;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .code-problem-prompt{font-size:14px!important;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;line-height:1.6!important;margin-bottom:12px!important;}
  .code-problem-prompt code{background:rgba(147,197,253,.12);color:#bfdbfe!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#bfdbfe!important;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:5px;font-size:12px;}
  .code-textarea{width:100%;min-height:120px;background:#020617;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:8px;padding:14px 16px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;color:#e2e8f0!important;resize:vertical;outline:none;line-height:1.8;}
  .code-textarea:focus{border-color:var(--bi3-lt);}
  .code-btn-row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;}
  .code-run-btn{padding:9px 20px!important;background:var(--bi3)!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;border:none!important;border-radius:7px!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:700!important;cursor:pointer!important;font-family:inherit!important;}
  .code-run-btn:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait;}
  .code-hint-btn,.code-sol-btn{padding:9px 16px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)!important;color:#94a3b8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#94a3b8!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)!important;border-radius:7px!important;font-size:13px!important;cursor:pointer!important;font-family:inherit!important;}
  .code-output{margin-top:10px;background:#020617;border-radius:8px;padding:12px 16px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;min-height:44px;display:none;line-height:1.7;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;color:#e2e8f0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#e2e8f0!important;}
  .code-output.show{display:block;}
  .code-output.ok{color:#4ade80!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#4ade80!important;}
  .code-output.err{color:#f87171!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#f87171!important;}
  .code-hint{margin-top:8px;background:rgba(147,197,253,.06);border:1px solid rgba(147,197,253,.2);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:13px;color:#bfdbfe!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#bfdbfe!important;display:none;line-height:1.6;}
  .code-hint.show{display:block;}
  .code-solution{margin-top:8px;background:rgba(74,222,128,.06);border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.2);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;color:#bbf7d0!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#bbf7d0!important;display:none;white-space:pre;line-height:1.8;overflow-x:auto;}
  .code-solution.show{display:block;}

  /* FAQ */
  .faq-section{margin-bottom:40px;}
  .faq-section h2{font-family:"DM Serif Display",serif!important;font-size:24px!important;color:var(--navy)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--navy)!important;margin-bottom:14px!important;padding-bottom:10px!important;border-bottom:2px solid var(--bi3-bg)!important;}
  .faq-item{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:10px;overflow:hidden;}
  .faq-q{width:100%;text-align:left;padding:16px 20px;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:15px!important;font-weight:600!important;color:var(--navy)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--navy)!important;font-family:inherit!important;line-height:1.4!important;}
  .faq-q:hover{background:#f8fafc;}
  .faq-icon{font-size:18px;color:var(--bi3)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3)!important;flex-shrink:0;transition:transform .2s;font-style:normal;}
  .faq-item.open .faq-icon{transform:rotate(45deg);}
  .faq-a{display:none;padding:0 20px 16px;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;line-height:1.7!important;border-top:1px solid #f1f5f9;}
  .faq-item.open .faq-a{display:block;}
  .faq-a code{background:#eef2ff;color:#1e3a8a!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#1e3a8a!important;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:5px;font-size:13px;}

  /* RELATED + SUPERPACK + TEACHER + NAV */
  .related-links{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:12px;padding:24px;margin-bottom:40px;}
  .related-links h3{font-size:15px!important;font-weight:700!important;color:var(--navy)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--navy)!important;margin-bottom:14px!important;}
  .related-links-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:8px;}
  .related-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:#f8fafc;text-decoration:none;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:500!important;color:var(--bi3)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3)!important;border:1px solid #bfdbfe;transition:background .15s;line-height:1.3;}
  .related-link:link,.related-link:visited{color:var(--bi3)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--bi3)!important;}
  .related-link:hover{background:var(--bi3-bg);}
  .related-ext{color:var(--slate)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--slate)!important;border-color:#e2e8f0;}
  .superpack-slim{background:#fff;border:1px solid #bfdbfe;border-radius:10px;padding:16px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:36px;}
  .superpack-slim-icon{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--bi3-bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .superpack-slim-text{font-size:14px;color:var(--navy)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--navy)!important;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3;}
  .superpack-slim-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);font-weight:400;display:block;margin-top:2px;}
  .superpack-slim-btn{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:6px!important;background:var(--bi3)!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;padding:9px 18px!important;border-radius:7px!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:600!important;text-decoration:none!important;white-space:nowrap!important;}
  .superpack-slim-btn:link,.superpack-slim-btn:visited{color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;}
  .teacher-callout{background:#f0f9ff;border:1px solid #bae6fd;border-radius:10px;padding:18px 22px;margin-bottom:28px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;}

  .teacher-callout-body{flex:1;}
  .teacher-callout-label{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#0369a1!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#0369a1!important;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .teacher-callout-body p{font-size:14px!important;color:#0c4a6e!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#0c4a6e!important;margin-bottom:0!important;line-height:1.6!important;}
  .teacher-callout-body a{color:#0369a1!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#0369a1!important;font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;}
  .lesson-nav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-bottom:40px;}
  .nav-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:10px;padding:16px 20px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;transition:box-shadow .15s;display:block;}

  <div class="lesson-main">

    <div class="lesson-objectives">
      <h2>After this lesson, you will be able to:</h2>
      <ul>
        <li><span>Define personally identifiable information (PII) and explain the risks of sharing it online</span></li>
        <li><span>Recognize the signs of a phishing message and describe how malware and social engineering attacks work</span></li>
        <li><span>Explain how strong unique passwords and multifactor authentication protect an account</span></li>
        <li><span>Describe what encryption does and distinguish symmetric encryption from public key encryption</span></li>
        <li><span>Choose appropriate safe computing practices for a given scenario</span></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="score-impact">📈 <span>Big Idea 5 (Impact of Computing) is 21 to 26 percent of the AP CSP exam, and safe computing questions on PII, phishing, authentication, and encryption are dependable points. The vocabulary is precise and testable, so a little memorization here converts directly into correct answers.</span>
</div>
    <div class="hook-box">
      <div class="hook-label">💡 Think about this first</div>
      <p>You get a text that looks like it is from your bank: it warns your account is locked and gives a link to 'verify your identity' by entering your password and Social Security number right now. The logo looks real and the message sounds urgent. Before you tap anything, what is the single biggest clue that this message might be a trap, and what should you do instead?</p>
    </div>
    <div class="lesson-section">
      <h2>Personally Identifiable Information (PII)</h2>
      <p><strong>Personally identifiable information (PII)</strong> is information that can be used to identify a specific individual, either on its own or combined with other data. Examples include your full name, home address, government identification number, phone number, email address, date of birth, biometric data such as a fingerprint or face scan, and your physical location.</p>
      <p>The core risk is simple: once information is online, it is very hard to remove and easy to copy. PII that gets exposed can be exploited for <strong>identity theft</strong>, used to <strong>track</strong> your movements and habits, or combined with other leaked data to launch <strong>targeted attacks</strong>. Even seemingly harmless details can be pieced together. Sharing less PII, and thinking before you post, reduces how much of you is exposed.</p>
      <div class="callout-exam">
        <div class="callout-exam-label">🎯 What the exam rewards</div>
        <p>When a question asks about the danger of sharing PII, the strongest answer names a concrete harm such as <strong>identity theft, tracking, or targeted attacks</strong>, and recognizes that information online is <strong>hard to remove and easy to copy</strong>. Answers about convenience or speed are distractors.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="lesson-section">
      <h2>Threats: Phishing, Malware, and Social Engineering</h2>
      <p>Most attacks on ordinary users do not break encryption. They trick the user.</p>
      <ul>
        <li>
<strong>Phishing</strong> is a fraudulent message, often an email or text, designed to trick you into revealing credentials or PII, or into clicking a malicious link. Phishing usually creates <strong>urgency</strong> ("act now or lose access"), impersonates a trusted source, and sends you to a fake page that harvests what you type.</li>
        <li>
<strong>Malware</strong> is malicious software, such as a virus, that is installed without your informed consent to damage a system, steal data, or take control of a device.</li>
        <li>
<strong>Social engineering</strong> is the broad category of manipulating people into giving up information or access. Phishing is one kind of social engineering.</li>
      </ul>
      <p>The common thread is that the human is the target. Signs of phishing include unexpected requests for a password or PII, links whose real address does not match the sender, pressure to act immediately, and small errors in the sender address or spelling.</p>
      <div class="mini-ex">
        <div class="mini-ex-label">Quick check</div>
        <div class="mini-ex-q">Which of these is the clearest sign that an email is a phishing attempt?</div>
        <div class="mini-opts" id="mc-safe-1-opts">
          <button class="mini-opt" onclick="miniMCQ('mc-safe-1','A','C','mc-safe-1-fb')"><span class="mini-opt-letter">A</span> The email is from a company you actually have an account with</button>
          <button class="mini-opt" onclick="miniMCQ('mc-safe-1','B','C','mc-safe-1-fb')"><span class="mini-opt-letter">B</span> The email contains an image in the signature</button>
          <button class="mini-opt" onclick="miniMCQ('mc-safe-1','C','C','mc-safe-1-fb')"><span class="mini-opt-letter">C</span> The email urgently demands your password through a link that does not match the sender's real address</button>
          <button class="mini-opt" onclick="miniMCQ('mc-safe-1','D','C','mc-safe-1-fb')"><span class="mini-opt-letter">D</span> The email was sent in the afternoon</button>
        </div>
        <div class="mini-fb" id="mc-safe-1-fb"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="lesson-section">
      <h2>Protections: Passwords and Multifactor Authentication</h2>
      <p>Your first defense is a <strong>strong, unique</strong> password: long, hard to guess, and different for every account so that one breach does not unlock the rest. But passwords alone can be stolen or phished, which is why the strongest protection adds more factors.</p>
      <p><strong>Multifactor authentication (MFA)</strong> requires proof from two or more <strong>different kinds</strong> of factors before granting access. The three categories are:</p>
      <table class="vocab-table">
        <tr>
<th>Factor type</th>
<th>Meaning</th>
<th>Example</th>
</tr>
        <tr>
<td><strong>Something you know</strong></td>
<td>Information only you should have</td>
<td>Password or PIN</td>
</tr>
        <tr>
<td><strong>Something you have</strong></td>
<td>A physical item or device</td>
<td>Phone receiving a code, or a security key</td>
</tr>
        <tr>
<td><strong>Something you are</strong></td>
<td>A biometric trait</td>
<td>Fingerprint or face scan</td>
</tr>
      </table>
      <p>The power of MFA is that an attacker who phishes your password still cannot log in without the second factor, such as the code on your phone. Other everyday protections include being cautious with links and app permissions, and keeping software updated so known vulnerabilities are patched.</p>
      <div class="callout-trap">
        <div class="callout-trap-label">⚠ Common trap</div>
        <p>Requiring <strong>two passwords</strong>, or a password plus a security question, is NOT multifactor authentication. Both are "something you know," so they are the <strong>same kind</strong> of factor. True multifactor combines <strong>different kinds</strong> of factors, such as a password (know) plus a code from your phone (have).</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="lesson-section">
      <h2>Encryption: Symmetric and Public Key</h2>
      <p><strong>Encryption</strong> encodes data so that only authorized parties can read it. The scrambled data means nothing to an eavesdropper without the correct key. There are two schemes you must distinguish:</p>
      <table class="vocab-table">
        <tr>
<th></th>
<th>Symmetric encryption</th>
<th>Public key (asymmetric) encryption</th>
</tr>
        <tr>
<td><strong>Keys used</strong></td>
<td>One shared key</td>
<td>A pair: a public key and a private key</td>
</tr>
        <tr>
<td><strong>How it works</strong></td>
<td>The same key both encrypts and decrypts</td>
<td>The public key encrypts; only the matching private key decrypts</td>
</tr>
        <tr>
<td><strong>Key sharing</strong></td>
<td>Both parties must already share the secret key</td>
<td>The public key can be shared openly; no secret must be exchanged first</td>
</tr>
      </table>
      <p>The key advantage of public key encryption is that two people who have never met can communicate securely. You publish your public key for anyone to use to encrypt a message to you, but you keep your private key secret, and only it can decrypt those messages. Symmetric encryption is fast but requires a way to share the one secret key safely in advance.</p>
      <div class="mini-ex">
        <div class="mini-ex-label">Quick check</div>
        <div class="mini-ex-q">A website publishes a key that anyone can use to encrypt a message to it, but only the website holds the separate key that can decrypt those messages. Which type of encryption is this?</div>
        <div class="mini-opts" id="mc-safe-2-opts">
          <button class="mini-opt" onclick="miniMCQ('mc-safe-2','A','B','mc-safe-2-fb')"><span class="mini-opt-letter">A</span> Symmetric encryption, because encryption is happening</button>
          <button class="mini-opt" onclick="miniMCQ('mc-safe-2','B','B','mc-safe-2-fb')"><span class="mini-opt-letter">B</span> Public key encryption, because a public key encrypts and a separate private key decrypts</button>
          <button class="mini-opt" onclick="miniMCQ('mc-safe-2','C','B','mc-safe-2-fb')"><span class="mini-opt-letter">C</span> Symmetric encryption, because one shared key is used for both steps</button>
          <button class="mini-opt" onclick="miniMCQ('mc-safe-2','D','B','mc-safe-2-fb')"><span class="mini-opt-letter">D</span> Neither, because encryption always uses exactly one key</button>
        </div>
        <div class="mini-fb" id="mc-safe-2-fb"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="lesson-section">
      <h2>How 5.6 Is Tested on the MCQ Exam</h2>
      <p>Safe computing appears on the multiple-choice section in a few predictable shapes. Expect a <strong>phishing scenario</strong> that describes a suspicious message and asks you to identify the warning sign or the safe response; the right answer names the mismatched link, the urgent request for credentials, or the choice to not click and to verify through a known channel. Expect a <strong>PII question</strong> that asks which item is personally identifiable or names the risk of sharing it, where the strong answer cites identity theft, tracking, or targeted attacks and the difficulty of removing information once it is online.</p>
      <p>Expect a <strong>multifactor authentication</strong> item that tests whether you understand factors must be of <strong>different kinds</strong> (know, have, are), so two passwords do not count. And expect an <strong>encryption</strong> item that checks the difference between <strong>symmetric</strong> encryption (one shared key for both directions) and <strong>public key</strong> encryption (a public key encrypts, a private key decrypts, no shared secret needed first). Precise vocabulary is what earns these points, so learn the exact definitions rather than the general vibe.</p>
    </div>

      <div class="mcq-item" data-activity="quiz" data-item="q1">
        <div class="mcq-q-num">Question 1 of 6<span class="diff-tag">Spot the phishing</span>
</div>
        <div class="predict-note">Predict the single strongest warning sign before reading the options.</div>
        <div class="mcq-q-text"><p>A student receives an email that appears to be from their school's login system. It says their account will be deleted in one hour unless they confirm their password by clicking a link, and the link's real address is a string of random characters unrelated to the school. Which feature most strongly indicates this is a phishing attempt?</p></div>
        <div class="mcq-options" id="q1-options">
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q1','A','A','q1-fb-A')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">A</span> The email combines an urgent deadline with a request to enter a password at a link whose real address does not match the school</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q1','B','A','q1-fb-B')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">B</span> The email is addressed to the student by their first name</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q1','C','A','q1-fb-C')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">C</span> The email was received during school hours</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q1','D','A','q1-fb-D')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">D</span> The email mentions the school's login system by name</button>
</div>
<div id="q1-fb-A" class="mcq-feedback correct-fb">Correct. Manufactured urgency plus a request for credentials at a mismatched link is the defining signature of phishing.</div>
<div id="q1-fb-B" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. Attackers often personalize emails with a name to seem legitimate, so a first-name greeting is not the warning sign.</div>
<div id="q1-fb-C" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. The time an email arrives is unrelated to whether it is fraudulent.</div>
<div id="q1-fb-D" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. Naming a real service is exactly what attackers do to impersonate a trusted source; it is not itself a warning sign.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="mcq-item" data-activity="quiz" data-item="q2">
        <div class="mcq-q-num">Question 2 of 6<span class="diff-tag">Encryption compare</span>
</div>
        <div class="predict-note">State the key difference in your own words first.</div>
        <div class="mcq-q-text"><p>Two people who have never communicated before want to exchange a secret message over the internet without first meeting to agree on a shared secret. Which approach makes this possible, and why?</p></div>
        <div class="mcq-options" id="q2-options">
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q2','A','A','q2-fb-A')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">A</span> Public key encryption, because the recipient's public key encrypts the message and only the recipient's private key can decrypt it</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q2','B','A','q2-fb-B')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">B</span> Symmetric encryption, because the same key is used to encrypt and decrypt</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q2','C','A','q2-fb-C')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">C</span> Symmetric encryption, because it is faster than other methods</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q2','D','A','q2-fb-D')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">D</span> Neither, because secure communication always requires meeting in person to exchange a key</button>
</div>
<div id="q2-fb-A" class="mcq-feedback correct-fb">Correct. Public key encryption lets the sender use the recipient's openly published public key, while only the recipient's private key can decrypt, so no prior shared secret is needed.</div>
<div id="q2-fb-B" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. Symmetric encryption needs both parties to already share one secret key, which is the very problem here.</div>
<div id="q2-fb-C" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. Speed does not solve the problem; symmetric encryption still requires a pre-shared secret key.</div>
<div id="q2-fb-D" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. Public key encryption specifically removes the need to meet in advance to share a key.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="mcq-item" data-activity="quiz" data-item="q3">
        <div class="mcq-q-num">Question 3 of 6<span class="diff-tag">I, II, III</span>
</div>
        <div class="predict-note">Decide which items are truly PII before matching an option.</div>
        <div class="mcq-q-text"><p>Consider the following pieces of information:</p></div>
        <ul class="mcq-roman">
          <li>
<strong>I.</strong> A person's government-issued identification number</li>
          <li>
<strong>II.</strong> A person's home address combined with their full name</li>
          <li>
<strong>III.</strong> The current outdoor temperature in a large city</li>
        </ul>
        <div class="mcq-options" id="q3-options">
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q3','A','C','q3-fb-A')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">A</span> I only</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q3','B','C','q3-fb-B')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">B</span> II and III only</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q3','C','C','q3-fb-C')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">C</span> I and II only</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q3','D','C','q3-fb-D')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">D</span> I, II, and III</button>
</div>
<div id="q3-fb-A" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. Item II also identifies a specific individual, so I alone is incomplete.</div>
<div id="q3-fb-B" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. Item III (a city temperature) identifies no individual and is not PII, and item I is PII, so this pairing fails.</div>
<div id="q3-fb-C" class="mcq-feedback correct-fb">Correct. A government ID number and a name plus home address both identify a specific individual, so they are PII. A city's temperature identifies no one.</div>
<div id="q3-fb-D" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. Item III is not PII, so not all three can be correct.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="mcq-item" data-activity="quiz" data-item="q4">
        <div class="mcq-q-num">Question 4 of 6<span class="diff-tag">Multifactor</span>
</div>
        <div class="predict-note">Decide what makes authentication truly multifactor first.</div>
        <div class="mcq-q-text"><p>A website wants to add multifactor authentication. Which change actually implements multifactor authentication?</p></div>
        <div class="mcq-options" id="q4-options">
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q4','A','D','q4-fb-A')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">A</span> Requiring a password and then a second, longer password</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q4','B','D','q4-fb-B')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">B</span> Requiring a password plus a security question about the user's first pet</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q4','C','D','q4-fb-C')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">C</span> Requiring the user to type their password twice to confirm it</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q4','D','D','q4-fb-D')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">D</span> Requiring a password plus a one-time code sent to the user's registered phone</button>
</div>
<div id="q4-fb-A" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. Two passwords are both 'something you know,' the same kind of factor, so this is not multifactor.</div>
<div id="q4-fb-B" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. A password and a security question are both 'something you know,' so they are the same factor type, not multiple factors.</div>
<div id="q4-fb-C" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. Typing the same password twice is confirmation, not a second factor of any kind.</div>
<div id="q4-fb-D" class="mcq-feedback correct-fb">Correct. A password ('something you know') plus a code on the user's phone ('something you have') combines two different kinds of factors, which is multifactor authentication.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="mcq-item" data-activity="quiz" data-item="q5">
        <div class="mcq-q-num">Question 5 of 6<span class="diff-tag">PII risk</span>
</div>
        <div class="predict-note">Predict the real harm of the exposure before you look.</div>
        <div class="mcq-q-text"><p>A user posts a photo online that automatically includes location data, along with their full name and daily schedule. Which outcome best describes the primary risk created by sharing this personally identifiable information?</p></div>
        <div class="mcq-options" id="q5-options">
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q5','A','A','q5-fb-A')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">A</span> The combined details could let someone track the user's movements or impersonate them, and the information is hard to remove once posted</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q5','B','A','q5-fb-B')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">B</span> The photo will load more slowly for other users</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q5','C','A','q5-fb-C')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">C</span> The user's device will run out of storage space</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q5','D','A','q5-fb-D')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">D</span> The photo will lose quality each time it is viewed</button>
</div>
<div id="q5-fb-A" class="mcq-feedback correct-fb">Correct. Location, name, and schedule together enable tracking and identity theft, and information posted online is difficult to remove or take back.</div>
<div id="q5-fb-B" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. Load speed is unrelated to the privacy risk of exposing PII.</div>
<div id="q5-fb-C" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. Posting a photo does not consume storage in a way that matters here, and it is not the PII risk.</div>
<div id="q5-fb-D" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. Viewing a photo does not degrade its quality, and this is not the privacy concern.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="mcq-item" data-activity="quiz" data-item="q6">
        <div class="mcq-q-num">Question 6 of 6<span class="diff-tag">Best response</span>
</div>
        <div class="predict-note">Predict the safest action before reading the choices.</div>
        <div class="mcq-q-text"><p>An employee receives an unexpected message claiming to be from their company's help desk, asking them to reply with their username and password to 'complete a required security update.' What is the safest response?</p></div>
        <div class="mcq-options" id="q6-options">
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q6','A','C','q6-fb-A')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">A</span> Reply with the credentials quickly so the account is not locked out</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q6','B','C','q6-fb-B')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">B</span> Forward the message to coworkers so they can send their credentials too</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q6','C','C','q6-fb-C')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">C</span> Do not reply or click anything, and verify the request through a known, official help desk channel</button>
<button class="mcq-option" onclick="checkMCQ('q6','D','C','q6-fb-D')"><span class="mcq-option-letter">D</span> Reply asking the sender to prove they are legitimate, then send the password if they answer</button>
</div>
<div id="q6-fb-A" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. Legitimate help desks do not ask for your password; complying hands your credentials to an attacker.</div>
<div id="q6-fb-B" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. Spreading the message endangers coworkers and does nothing to verify the request.</div>
<div id="q6-fb-C" class="mcq-feedback correct-fb">Correct. Refusing to respond and confirming through an independent official channel defeats the phishing attempt without risking your credentials.</div>
<div id="q6-fb-D" class="mcq-feedback incorrect-fb">Incorrect. An attacker can easily fake a reply, and you should never send a password in a message regardless.</div>
      </div>

<script>
(function(){
  var stage = document.getElementById('pn-stage');
  var elScore = document.getElementById('pn-score');
  var elStreak = document.getElementById('pn-streak');

  var score = 0, streak = 0, best = 0, idx = 0, answered = false;

  // ---- Inbox: escalating difficulty. p=true means phishing. ----
  var INBOX = [
    { chan:'email', cls:'', from:'PayPal Security <service@paypa1-secure.com>',
      subj:'Your account has been LIMITED - verify in 24 hours',
      text:'We noticed unusual activity. Confirm your password now or your account will be permanently closed.',
      url:'http://paypa1-secure.com/verify', p:true,
      cue:'Look-alike URL (paypa1 with a "1"), false urgency, and it asks for your password. Real sites never do all three.' },

    { chan:'email', cls:'', from:'GitHub <noreply@github.com>',
      subj:'A new SSH key was added to your account',
      text:'If you did this you can ignore this email. If not, review your security settings from your account page.',
      url:'https://github.com/settings/keys', p:false,

    { chan:'text', cls:'txt', from:'+1 (830) 555-0147',

    { chan:'email', cls:'', from:'School IT Helpdesk <helpdesk@yourschool.edu>',
      subj:'Scheduled password reset this weekend',

    { chan:'email', cls:'', from:'HR Department <hr@company-payrol.com>',

      text:'Pleese review the attached form and reply with you bank login to keep you salary on time.',
      url:'', attach:'DirectDeposit_Update.html.zip', p:true,

    { chan:'web', cls:'web', from:'https://accounts.google.com',
      subj:'Sign in - Google',
      text:'Standard Google sign-in page. The address bar shows a padlock and the exact google.com domain.',
      url:'https://accounts.google.com/signin', p:false,

    { chan:'text', cls:'txt', from:'VERIFY-CODE',

      text:'A caller says they are from fraud dept and asks you to READ THEM this code to cancel a charge.',
      url:'', p:true,
      cue:'Never share an MFA code. The code is the phish here - real staff never ask you to read it aloud.' },

    { chan:'web', cls:'web', from:'http://secure-bankofamericaa.com',

      text:'Looks like your bank login, but the address bar has no padlock and the domain has a doubled letter.',
      url:'http://secure-bankofamericaa.com/login', p:true,
      cue:'No HTTPS padlock (unencrypted) and a doubled-letter look-alike domain. Two red flags at once.' },

    { chan:'email', cls:'', from:'Amazon <ship-confirm@amazon.com>',

    { chan:'email', cls:'', from:'IT Security <it-support@micros0ft-alerts.net>',

  // ---- Bonus round: Secure the Account ----
  var BONUS = [
    { q:'Pick the STRONGEST password for your account.',

        { t:'password123', ok:false },
        { t:'P@ssw0rd', ok:false },
        { t:'7mQz-vine!Cloud-42', ok:true },

    { q:'You just set a password. What should you turn on next?',
      hint:'Something a stolen password alone cannot get past.',
      opts:[
        { t:'Multi-factor authentication (a second code or key)', ok:true },
        { t:'Save the password in a public shared doc', ok:false },

    { q:'Which site is safe to enter your login on?',

      opts:[
        { t:'http://my-bank-login.co  (no padlock)', ok:false },
        { t:'https://www.mybank.com  (padlock, correct domain)', ok:true },

  ];

  function setStats(){
    elScore.textContent = score;
    elStreak.textContent = streak;
    var total = INBOX.length + BONUS.length;
    elProg.textContent = Math.min(idx + 1, total) + '/' + total;

  function renderInbox(){
    answered = false;
    var m = INBOX[idx];
    var html = '<p class="pn-phase-label">Incoming • Round ' + (idx+1) + '</p>';
    html += '<div class="pn-msg"><div class="pn-msg-top">';
    var label = m.chan==='text' ? 'Text' : (m.chan==='web' ? 'Login Page' : 'Email');
    html += '<span class="pn-chan ' + m.cls + '">' + label + '</span>';
    html += '<span class="pn-from">' + esc(m.from) + '</span></div>';
    html += '<div class="pn-msg-body"><p class="pn-subj">' + esc(m.subj) + '</p>';
    html += '<p class="pn-text">' + esc(m.text) + '</p>';

    document.getElementById('pn-phish').onclick = function(){ answerInbox(true); };
    document.getElementById('pn-safe').onclick = function(){ answerInbox(false); };
    setStats();
  }

  function answerInbox(guessPhish){
    if(answered) return;
    answered = true;
    var m = INBOX[idx];
    var correct = (guessPhish === m.p);
    document.getElementById('pn-phish').disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('pn-safe').disabled = true;
    if(correct){
      streak++;
      var pts = 100 + (streak >= 3 ? 50 : 0);
      score += pts;
    } else {
      streak = 0;
    }
    setStats();
    var actual = m.p ? 'This was PHISHING.' : 'This was SAFE.';
    var slot = document.getElementById('pn-fbslot');
    slot.innerHTML =
      '<div class="pn-fb ' + (correct?'good':'bad') + '">' +
        '<span class="verdict">' + (correct?'✓ Correct! ':'✗ Not quite. ') + actual + (correct?' +'+ (100 + (streak>=3?50:0)) +' pts':'') + '</span>' +
        '<span class="note">' + esc(m.cue) + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<button class="pn-next" id="pn-next">' + (idx < INBOX.length-1 ? 'Next message ▶' : 'Start bonus round ▶') + '</button>';
    document.getElementById('pn-next').onclick = advance;
  }

  function advance(){
    idx++;
    if(idx < INBOX.length){ renderInbox(); }
    else { bonusIdx = 0; renderBonus(); }
  }

  var bonusIdx = 0;
  function renderBonus(){
    answered = false;
    var b = BONUS[bonusIdx];
    var html = '<p class="pn-phase-label">🔒 Secure the Account • ' + (bonusIdx+1) + '/' + BONUS.length + '</p>';

    html += '<p class="pn-bonus-hint">' + esc(b.hint) + '</p>';
    html += '<div class="pn-opts">';

      html += '<button class="pn-opt" data-i="' + i + '">' + esc(b.opts[i].t) + '</button>';
    }
    html += '</div><div id="pn-fbslot"></div>';
    stage.innerHTML = html;
    var btns = stage.querySelectorAll('.pn-opt');
    for(var j=0;j<btns.length;j++){
      btns[j].onclick = function(){ answerBonus(parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-i'),10)); };
    }
    setStats();
  }

  function answerBonus(choice){
    if(answered) return;
    answered = true;
    var b = BONUS[bonusIdx];
    var correct = b.opts[choice].ok;
    var btns = stage.querySelectorAll('.pn-opt');
    for(var i=0;i<btns.length;i++){
      btns[i].disabled = true;
      if(b.opts[i].ok){ btns[i].className = 'pn-opt right'; }
      else if(i===choice){ btns[i].className = 'pn-opt wrong'; }
    }
    if(correct){ streak++; score += 150; }
    else { streak = 0; }
    setStats();
    var slot = document.getElementById('pn-fbslot');
    slot.innerHTML =
      '<div class="pn-fb ' + (correct?'good':'bad') + '">' +
        '<span class="verdict">' + (correct?'✓ Locked in! +150 pts':'✗ That one is weak.') + '</span>' +
        '<span class="note">' + esc(b.note) + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<button class="pn-next" id="pn-next">' + (bonusIdx < BONUS.length-1 ? 'Next ▶' : 'See results ▶') + '</button>';
    document.getElementById('pn-next').onclick = function(){
      bonusIdx++;
      if(bonusIdx < BONUS.length){ renderBonus(); }
      else { endGame(); }
    };
  }

  function endGame(){
    var maxScore = INBOX.length*150 + BONUS.length*150; // generous ceiling
    var pct = score / (INBOX.length*100 + BONUS.length*150);
    var em, title, msg;
    if(pct >= 0.9){ em='🛡'; title='Firewall Legend'; msg='You caught the look-alike URLs, refused the codes, and locked every account. That is real safe-computing instinct.'; }
    else if(pct >= 0.65){ em='🐛'; title='Sharp Net'; msg='Strong phishing radar. Keep watching for mismatched domains and the missing HTTPS padlock to reach the top.'; }
    else { em='🕵'; title='Training Sights'; msg='Every miss is a lesson: check the domain, distrust urgency, never share passwords or codes, and look for the padlock.'; }

    stage.innerHTML =
      '<div class="pn-end">' +
        '<div class="em">' + em + '</div>' +
        '<h2>' + title + '</h2>' +
        '<p class="final">Final score: <b>' + score + '</b></p>' +
        '<div class="accents">' +
          '<span class="pn-pill">Spot look-alike URLs</span>' +
          '<span class="pn-pill">Use MFA</span>' +
          '<span class="pn-pill">Trust the HTTPS padlock</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<p class="msg">' + msg + '</p>' +
        '<button class="pn-again" id="pn-again">▶ Play again</button>' +
      '</div>';
    document.getElementById('pn-again').onclick = start;
    idx = INBOX.length + BONUS.length - 1;
    setStats();
    try{ document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('apcsGameScore',{detail:{value:score}})); }catch(e){}
  }

  function start(){
    score = 0; streak = 0; idx = 0; bonusIdx = 0; answered = false;
    setStats();
    renderInbox();
  }

  function esc(s){
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function(c){
      return {'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"'}[c];
    });
  }

  start();
})();
</script>

      <h2>Frequently Asked Questions</h2>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFAQ(this)">What exactly counts as personally identifiable information (PII)?<i class="faq-icon">+</i></button>
        <div class="faq-a">PII is any information that can identify a specific individual, alone or combined with other data. Common examples are your full name, home address, government identification number, phone number, email address, date of birth, biometric data, and location. Even ordinary details can become identifying when combined.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFAQ(this)">How can I recognize a phishing message?<i class="faq-icon">+</i></button>
        <div class="faq-a">Watch for an urgent demand to act immediately, an unexpected request for your password or PII, a link whose real address does not match the claimed sender, and small errors in the sender's address or spelling. When in doubt, do not click; verify through a known official channel instead.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFAQ(this)">Why is multifactor authentication stronger than just a password?<i class="faq-icon">+</i></button>
        <div class="faq-a">Multifactor authentication requires two or more different kinds of factors, such as something you know (a password) plus something you have (a code on your phone). An attacker who steals or phishes your password still cannot log in without the second factor, so a single leaked password is no longer enough.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFAQ(this)">What is the difference between symmetric and public key encryption?<i class="faq-icon">+</i></button>
        <div class="faq-a">Symmetric encryption uses one shared key to both encrypt and decrypt, so both parties must already share that secret. Public key encryption uses a pair of keys: a public key that anyone can use to encrypt, and a private key that only the owner holds to decrypt. Public key encryption lets strangers communicate securely without sharing a secret in advance.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFAQ(this)">Is two passwords the same as multifactor authentication?<i class="faq-icon">+</i></button>
        <div class="faq-a">No. Two passwords, or a password plus a security question, are both 'something you know,' which is a single kind of factor. Multifactor authentication requires different kinds of factors, such as a password combined with a code from your phone or a fingerprint.</div>

var MINI_MSGS={"mc-safe-1": {"A": "No. Real messages also come from companies you have accounts with, and attackers impersonate exactly those companies.
